title: 库存周转率、周转天数与库存金额
learningObjective: 能够按仓库类别独立计算成本口径的库存周转，并识别缺失快照。
concept: 库存金额是某一时点的数量乘单位成本；销售成本是期间流量。平均库存取期初与期末库存金额的平均。周转率=净销售出库成本÷平均库存；周转天数=365×平均库存÷净销售出库成本。周转率以次为单位，不能和百分比混淆。两端均值是近似值，不能代替高频日均库存。
useCase: 2025全年，按仓库×类别输出。销售出库数量为负，退货入库为正，均取负号乘成本使退货冲减出库成本；采购不计入。期初为2024-12-31，期末为2025-12-31。每仓每商品每个日期必须有唯一快照且金额字段有效；缺失不视为零。无销售成本且库存为正时周转率为0、天数未定义。负净成本需复核。
comparison: 售价库存金额不是成本库存金额；覆盖天数不是周转天数。

commonError.example: 用期末售价金额作分母，或者把缺失快照填零。
commonError.correction: 使用成本价、两端快照并检查唯一性和完整性。

teaching.problem: 2025全年，按仓库×类别输出。销售出库数量为负，退货入库为正，均取负号乘成本使退货冲减出库成本；采购不计入。期初为2024-12-31，期末为2025-12-31。每仓每商品每个日期必须有唯一快照且金额字段有效；缺失不视为零。无销售成本且库存为正时周转率为0、天数未定义。负净成本需复核。
teaching.codeExplanation: 先按商品主档把流水归入类别，使用 CASE 仅累计销售与退货；直接对所有出入库求和会混入采购。再交叉连接仓库与类别，匹配商品和指定日期快照，求数量×成本的总额并除2。原查询用快照总数等于商品数两倍检测完整性，前提是键唯一；若存在同日期重复，应先检查唯一性，否则一端重复可能掩盖另一端缺失。最后左连接两个同粒度汇总，NULLIF 避免零分母，周转天数用未舍入的成本与平均库存计算。
teaching.resultExplanation: 示例仓1类别1：销售成本1000减退货200=800，期初1000、期末600，均值800，周转1次、365天。仓1类别2缺期末，指标为空。仓2类别1两端均为0，非缺失但周转率无定义。仓2类别2成本800、平均800，周转1次。原企业预览仓1类别1为0.2487次、1467.69天，仅提示慢周转，仍需核对期间成本、库存结构和快照完整性。

mergedConcepts.explanation: 库存价值按数量×单位成本汇总，不能按售价估算成本。
两端平均库存、退货冲回、零及缺失分母、非正销售成本的天数处理。

mergeExamples.label: 小型示例：净销售出库成本
mergeExamples.explanation: 采购入库不属于销售成本，退货冲回200。
mergeExamples.sql:
WITH warehouses(warehouse_id) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2),
categories(category_id) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2),
products(product_id,category_id) AS (SELECT 1,1 UNION ALL SELECT 2,2),
stock_movements(warehouse_id,product_id,movement_date,movement_type,quantity_delta,unit_cost_cents) AS (SELECT 1,1,'2025-03-01','sale',-10,100 UNION ALL SELECT 1,1,'2025-04-01','return',2,100 UNION ALL SELECT 1,1,'2025-05-01','purchase',20,100 UNION ALL SELECT 1,2,'2025-01-01','sale',-5,200 UNION ALL SELECT 2,2,'2025-03-01','sale',-4,200),
inventory_snapshots(snapshot_id,warehouse_id,product_id,snapshot_date,quantity,unit_cost_cents) AS (SELECT 1,1,1,'2024-12-31',10,100 UNION ALL SELECT 2,1,1,'2025-12-31',6,100 UNION ALL SELECT 3,1,2,'2024-12-31',5,200 UNION ALL SELECT 4,2,1,'2024-12-31',0,100 UNION ALL SELECT 5,2,1,'2025-12-31',0,100 UNION ALL SELECT 6,2,2,'2024-12-31',4,200 UNION ALL SELECT 7,2,2,'2025-12-31',4,200),
a AS (SELECT warehouse_id,p.category_id,SUM(CASE WHEN movement_type='sale' THEN -quantity_delta*unit_cost_cents WHEN movement_type='return' THEN -quantity_delta*unit_cost_cents ELSE 0 END) cogs FROM stock_movements m JOIN products p ON p.product_id=m.product_id WHERE movement_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY warehouse_id,p.category_id),
b AS (SELECT w.warehouse_id,c.category_id,CASE WHEN COUNT(i.snapshot_id)=2*COUNT(DISTINCT p.product_id) THEN SUM(i.quantity*i.unit_cost_cents)/2.0 ELSE NULL END avg_stock FROM warehouses w CROSS JOIN categories c LEFT JOIN products p ON p.category_id=c.category_id LEFT JOIN inventory_snapshots i ON i.warehouse_id=w.warehouse_id AND i.product_id=p.product_id AND i.snapshot_date IN ('2024-12-31','2025-12-31') GROUP BY w.warehouse_id,c.category_id)
SELECT * FROM a ORDER BY warehouse_id,category_id;

b AS (SELECT w.warehouse_id,c.category_id,CASE WHEN COUNT(i.snapshot_id)=2*COUNT(DISTINCT p.product_id) THEN SUM(i.quantity*i.unit_cost_cents)/2.0 ELSE NULL END avg_stock FROM warehouses w CROSS JOIN categories c LEFT JOIN products p ON p.category_id=c.category_id LEFT JOIN inventory_snapshots i ON i.warehouse_id=w.warehouse_id AND i.product_id=p.product_id AND i.snapshot_date IN ('2024-12-31','2025-12-31') GROUP BY w.warehouse_id,c.category_id)

title: 库存积压、滞销与缺货预警
learningObjective: 能够根据成本金额、出库速度及补货阈值识别库存风险。
concept: 积压表示资金占用相对需求偏高；滞销表示观察期内无销售或销售极慢；缺货风险表示库存不足以覆盖预计需求。库存覆盖天数=期末数量÷期间日均销售出库量。该指标描述按历史速度能卖多久，不等于实际售罄日期。
useCase: 主案例：2025-10-03至12-31共90天，按仓库商品计算毛销售出库数量（不扣退货），期末有效商品，库存成本价值严格大于500000分、销量严格小于20件。确认流水完整后无销售记0，零销量的覆盖天数为空。补充双向规则另用12-02至12-31共30天：销量至少30且可用量不足15日需求为缺货风险；销量不超过3且成本库存至少300000分为积压。示例假设快照数量等于可用量，实际须扣预留并按业务定义可售数量。
executionSteps: 计算库存价值及覆盖天数
筛选积压并检查缺货风险
comparison: 覆盖天数高不是充分证据，零销量也不是零天；不同观察期的规则不能混用。

commonError.example: 使用全公司销量匹配单仓库存，或者将无销量覆盖天数填0。
commonError.correction: 按仓库商品匹配并保留 NULL；分别计算90日和30日指标。

teaching.problem: 主案例：2025-10-03至12-31共90天，按仓库商品计算毛销售出库数量（不扣退货），期末有效商品，库存成本价值严格大于500000分、销量严格小于20件。确认流水完整后无销售记0，零销量的覆盖天数为空。补充双向规则另用12-02至12-31共30天：销量至少30且可用量不足15日需求为缺货风险；销量不超过3且成本库存至少300000分为积压。示例假设快照数量等于可用量，实际须扣预留并按业务定义可售数量。
teaching.codeExplanation: s 按仓库商品汇总 sale 类型，数量取负号成为正销量；不要加退货或期外数据。库存快照以同仓同商品左接销售汇总，保留零销量商品。主查询先限定有效状态与快照日，再用成本价值及销量阈值筛选。补充查询单独计算30日销量，不得把90日销量代入30日规则；缺货判断用数量比较 15×销量/30，避免除零。补货阈值则来自商品自身，不是所有商品固定同一数量。
teaching.resultExplanation: 主示例商品1库存价值600000分、销量10、覆盖900天；商品2价值560000分、销量0、覆盖天数空，仍是滞销候选。商品4虽然高库存但已停用，排除；商品5价值400000分未达到90日规则。30日规则下商品3销量40、库存5，低于20件需求，属于缺货风险；商品1、2、5为积压候选。原企业预览仓3商品339库存282件、90日销量9、覆盖2820天，需要核对季节备货、在途及数据完整性，不代表必然积压。

mergedConcepts.explanation: 高库存金额只是初筛，需结合季节性、需求及安全库存。
按同仓同日库存与商品补货阈值识别低库存。
无销售但仍有库存时保留滞销候选，覆盖天数未定义。
30日双向库存规则：畅销缺货与低销量积压分别判定。

mergeExamples.label: 小型示例：完整积压筛选
mergeExamples.explanation: 满足严格金额与销量门槛的两件商品。
mergeExamples.sql:
WITH products(product_id,active,reorder_level) AS (SELECT 1,1,10 UNION ALL SELECT 2,1,5 UNION ALL SELECT 3,1,20 UNION ALL SELECT 4,0,5 UNION ALL SELECT 5,1,10),
inventory_snapshots(warehouse_id,product_id,snapshot_date,quantity,unit_cost_cents) AS (SELECT 1,1,'2025-12-31',100,6000 UNION ALL SELECT 1,2,'2025-12-31',70,8000 UNION ALL SELECT 1,3,'2025-12-31',5,1000 UNION ALL SELECT 1,4,'2025-12-31',100,9000 UNION ALL SELECT 1,5,'2025-12-31',50,8000),
stock_movements(warehouse_id,product_id,movement_type,movement_date,quantity_delta) AS (SELECT 1,1,'sale','2025-11-01',-10 UNION ALL SELECT 1,3,'sale','2025-12-10',-40 UNION ALL SELECT 1,4,'sale','2025-12-01',-1 UNION ALL SELECT 1,5,'sale','2025-12-03',-3 UNION ALL SELECT 1,1,'return','2025-12-20',2 UNION ALL SELECT 1,2,'sale','2025-10-01',-50),
s AS (SELECT warehouse_id,product_id,SUM(-quantity_delta) sold FROM stock_movements WHERE movement_type='sale' AND movement_date BETWEEN '2025-10-03' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY warehouse_id,product_id)
SELECT i.warehouse_id,i.product_id,i.quantity,COALESCE(s.sold,0) sold_units,i.quantity*i.unit_cost_cents stock_value_cents,ROUND(90.0*i.quantity/NULLIF(s.sold,0),2) cover_days FROM inventory_snapshots i JOIN products p ON p.product_id=i.product_id LEFT JOIN s ON s.warehouse_id=i.warehouse_id AND s.product_id=i.product_id WHERE p.active=1 AND i.snapshot_date='2025-12-31' AND i.quantity*i.unit_cost_cents>500000 AND COALESCE(s.sold,0)<20 ORDER BY stock_value_cents DESC,i.warehouse_id,i.product_id;

mergeExamples.label: 小型示例：商品补货阈值
mergeExamples.explanation: 商品3库存低于自身阈值。
mergeExamples.sql:
WITH products(product_id,active,reorder_level) AS (SELECT 1,1,10 UNION ALL SELECT 2,1,5 UNION ALL SELECT 3,1,20 UNION ALL SELECT 4,0,5 UNION ALL SELECT 5,1,10),
inventory_snapshots(warehouse_id,product_id,snapshot_date,quantity,unit_cost_cents) AS (SELECT 1,1,'2025-12-31',100,6000 UNION ALL SELECT 1,2,'2025-12-31',70,8000 UNION ALL SELECT 1,3,'2025-12-31',5,1000 UNION ALL SELECT 1,4,'2025-12-31',100,9000 UNION ALL SELECT 1,5,'2025-12-31',50,8000),
stock_movements(warehouse_id,product_id,movement_type,movement_date,quantity_delta) AS (SELECT 1,1,'sale','2025-11-01',-10 UNION ALL SELECT 1,3,'sale','2025-12-10',-40 UNION ALL SELECT 1,4,'sale','2025-12-01',-1 UNION ALL SELECT 1,5,'sale','2025-12-03',-3 UNION ALL SELECT 1,1,'return','2025-12-20',2 UNION ALL SELECT 1,2,'sale','2025-10-01',-50),
s AS (SELECT warehouse_id,product_id,SUM(-quantity_delta) sold FROM stock_movements WHERE movement_type='sale' AND movement_date BETWEEN '2025-10-03' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY warehouse_id,product_id)
SELECT i.product_id,i.quantity,p.reorder_level FROM inventory_snapshots i JOIN products p ON p.product_id=i.product_id WHERE p.active=1 AND i.snapshot_date='2025-12-31' AND i.quantity<=p.reorder_level ORDER BY i.product_id;

mergeExamples.label: 小型示例：30日双向预警
mergeExamples.explanation: 近30日销量和库存价值重新计算，商品3缺货。
mergeExamples.sql:
WITH products(product_id,active,reorder_level) AS (SELECT 1,1,10 UNION ALL SELECT 2,1,5 UNION ALL SELECT 3,1,20 UNION ALL SELECT 4,0,5 UNION ALL SELECT 5,1,10),
inventory_snapshots(warehouse_id,product_id,snapshot_date,quantity,unit_cost_cents) AS (SELECT 1,1,'2025-12-31',100,6000 UNION ALL SELECT 1,2,'2025-12-31',70,8000 UNION ALL SELECT 1,3,'2025-12-31',5,1000 UNION ALL SELECT 1,4,'2025-12-31',100,9000 UNION ALL SELECT 1,5,'2025-12-31',50,8000),
stock_movements(warehouse_id,product_id,movement_type,movement_date,quantity_delta) AS (SELECT 1,1,'sale','2025-11-01',-10 UNION ALL SELECT 1,3,'sale','2025-12-10',-40 UNION ALL SELECT 1,4,'sale','2025-12-01',-1 UNION ALL SELECT 1,5,'sale','2025-12-03',-3 UNION ALL SELECT 1,1,'return','2025-12-20',2 UNION ALL SELECT 1,2,'sale','2025-10-01',-50),
s30 AS (SELECT warehouse_id,product_id,SUM(-quantity_delta) sold FROM stock_movements WHERE movement_type='sale' AND movement_date BETWEEN '2025-12-02' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY warehouse_id,product_id)
SELECT i.product_id,COALESCE(s30.sold,0) sold30,i.quantity, i.quantity*i.unit_cost_cents stock_value,CASE WHEN COALESCE(s30.sold,0)>=30 AND i.quantity<15.0*s30.sold/30 THEN '缺货风险' WHEN COALESCE(s30.sold,0)<=3 AND i.quantity*i.unit_cost_cents>=300000 THEN '积压候选' ELSE '其他' END AS risk FROM inventory_snapshots i JOIN products p ON p.product_id=i.product_id LEFT JOIN s30 ON s30.warehouse_id=i.warehouse_id AND s30.product_id=i.product_id WHERE p.active=1 AND i.snapshot_date='2025-12-31' ORDER BY i.product_id;

title: 客户复购率与统计粒度
learningObjective: 能够从订单粒度转换到客户粒度，正确计算期间复购人数与复购率。
concept: 复购率是期间有至少两笔有效购买的客户人数÷有至少一笔有效购买的客户人数×100%。不是复购订单占比，也不是所有注册客户中复购客户的占比。一个订单可能有多条商品明细，必须按订单编号计数；同一客户的有效订单次数再用于分类。
useCase: 2025全年、线上、已完成且扣退款后净额大于0的订单，关联客户主档。全额退款、取消、待付款、期外或线下订单不计。原项目净订单视图已经处理已完成状态及退款；再次扣退款会重复冲减。无有效购买客户时返回人数0、比率NULL。
executionSteps: 按客户计算不同订单数
comparison: 分母不是订单数、注册人数或商品行数；本期复购与历史首购分群不同。

commonError.example: 直接在订单明细层用 COUNT(*) 算购买次数，或以所有客户为分母。
commonError.correction: 先计算不同有效订单数，再在客户粒度统计人数。

teaching.problem: 2025全年、线上、已完成且扣退款后净额大于0的订单，关联客户主档。全额退款、取消、待付款、期外或线下订单不计。原项目净订单视图已经处理已完成状态及退款；再次扣退款会重复冲减。无有效购买客户时返回人数0、比率NULL。
teaching.codeExplanation: 先在订单层过滤范围和净额，再连接客户主档排除无有效客户编号的记录。COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) 保证一笔订单只数一次；GROUP BY c.customer_id 将订单粒度转换为客户粒度。外层 COUNT(*) 是购买客户人数，因为内层每人仅一行；SUM(CASE WHEN purchase_count>=2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) 给每位复购客户计1。乘100.0、NULLIF 防止整数截断和除零，COALESCE 让空输入的复购人数为0。独立示例直接模拟已处理好的订单视图，不代表原始订单表的全部记录。
teaching.resultExplanation: 客户1两笔有效订单，客户2一笔有效订单且另一笔全退；客户3的线上订单在2026年、线下订单不纳入；客户4无有效订单。分母2人、分子1人，复购率50%。原项目小型案例也给出2、1、50。这个比率仅反映本期至少购买两次的情况，不能解释历史老客户占比，也不能证明复购增长。

mergeExamples.label: 小型示例：有效订单明细
mergeExamples.explanation: 全退、期外、线下均排除。
mergeExamples.sql:
WITH customers(customer_id) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4),
v_order_net(order_id,customer_id,channel,order_date,net_cents) AS (SELECT 5,1,'online','2025-01-02',100 UNION ALL SELECT 6,1,'online','2025-03-02',60 UNION ALL SELECT 7,2,'online','2025-03-03',40 UNION ALL SELECT 8,2,'online','2025-04-03',0 UNION ALL SELECT 11,3,'online','2026-01-01',200 UNION ALL SELECT 12,3,'store','2025-05-01',100),
purchases AS (SELECT c.customer_id,COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) purchase_count FROM customers c JOIN v_order_net o ON o.customer_id=c.customer_id WHERE o.channel='online' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' AND o.net_cents>0 GROUP BY c.customer_id)
SELECT order_id,customer_id,net_cents FROM v_order_net WHERE channel='online' AND order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' AND net_cents>0 ORDER BY order_id;

mergeExamples.label: 小型示例：客户购买次数
mergeExamples.explanation: 每人一行，客户1计两次。
mergeExamples.sql:
WITH customers(customer_id) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4),
v_order_net(order_id,customer_id,channel,order_date,net_cents) AS (SELECT 5,1,'online','2025-01-02',100 UNION ALL SELECT 6,1,'online','2025-03-02',60 UNION ALL SELECT 7,2,'online','2025-03-03',40 UNION ALL SELECT 8,2,'online','2025-04-03',0 UNION ALL SELECT 11,3,'online','2026-01-01',200 UNION ALL SELECT 12,3,'store','2025-05-01',100),
purchases AS (SELECT c.customer_id,COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) purchase_count FROM customers c JOIN v_order_net o ON o.customer_id=c.customer_id WHERE o.channel='online' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' AND o.net_cents>0 GROUP BY c.customer_id)
SELECT * FROM purchases ORDER BY customer_id;

mergeExamples.label: 小型示例：完整复购率
mergeExamples.explanation: 外层按客户数计算。
mergeExamples.sql:
WITH customers(customer_id) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4),
v_order_net(order_id,customer_id,channel,order_date,net_cents) AS (SELECT 5,1,'online','2025-01-02',100 UNION ALL SELECT 6,1,'online','2025-03-02',60 UNION ALL SELECT 7,2,'online','2025-03-03',40 UNION ALL SELECT 8,2,'online','2025-04-03',0 UNION ALL SELECT 11,3,'online','2026-01-01',200 UNION ALL SELECT 12,3,'store','2025-05-01',100),
purchases AS (SELECT c.customer_id,COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) purchase_count FROM customers c JOIN v_order_net o ON o.customer_id=c.customer_id WHERE o.channel='online' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' AND o.net_cents>0 GROUP BY c.customer_id)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS purchasing_customers,COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN purchase_count>=2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS repeat_customers,ROUND(100.0*COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN purchase_count>=2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0)/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0),2) AS repeat_pct FROM purchases;

mergeExamples.label: 小型示例：空分母边界
mergeExamples.explanation: 将期间改为无有效订单的2023年。
mergeExamples.sql:
WITH customers(customer_id) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4),
v_order_net(order_id,customer_id,channel,order_date,net_cents) AS (SELECT 5,1,'online','2025-01-02',100 UNION ALL SELECT 6,1,'online','2025-03-02',60 UNION ALL SELECT 7,2,'online','2025-03-03',40 UNION ALL SELECT 8,2,'online','2025-04-03',0 UNION ALL SELECT 11,3,'online','2026-01-01',200 UNION ALL SELECT 12,3,'store','2025-05-01',100),
purchases AS (SELECT c.customer_id,COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) purchase_count FROM customers c JOIN v_order_net o ON o.customer_id=c.customer_id WHERE o.channel='online' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31' AND o.net_cents>0 GROUP BY c.customer_id)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS purchasing_customers,COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN purchase_count>=2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS repeat_customers,ROUND(100.0*COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN purchase_count>=2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0)/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0),2) AS repeat_pct FROM purchases;

title: 新老客户收入与客单价
learningObjective: 能够先识别历史首购，再统计报告期首购订单和复购订单的收入及客单价。
concept: 首购是客户在有效线上订单历史中的第一笔订单，而不是报告期内第一笔。客户与订单是两种不同粒度：本题给订单贴首购或复购标签，同一客户可在两个组出现。客单价=订单净额合计÷订单数；人均消费=净额合计÷去重客户数，二者回答不同问题。
useCase: 2025年度线上有效订单；先使用完整历史，以订单日期和订单编号共同决定顺序。金额为马币分。依赖原视图的有效订单和退款口径，不额外把所有净额为零的订单排除；如业务调整有效定义，历史和本期必须统一。
comparison: 订单级首购分类不等于按客户首次购买年份互斥划分新老客群。

commonError.example: 先过滤2025年再排名，或用客户人数作为客单价分母。
commonError.correction: 使用完整历史排名；按订单数量计算客单价，另行报告客户数。

teaching.problem: 2025年度线上有效订单；先使用完整历史，以订单日期和订单编号共同决定顺序。金额为马币分。依赖原视图的有效订单和退款口径，不额外把所有净额为零的订单排除；如业务调整有效定义，历史和本期必须统一。
teaching.codeExplanation: ROW_NUMBER 按客户分区，日期相同时用订单编号决胜，确保首购只有一笔。先排名，再用外层 WHERE 筛时间。CASE 把序号1标为首购，其余标为复购；COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) 数分组内的客户，COUNT(*) 数订单（前提是订单视图每订单一行），SUM 汇总净额，1.0 保留小数运算。
teaching.resultExplanation: 小型示例：客户1在2024年已有线上订单，2025年的1500分属于复购；客户2同日两单，编号3为首购，编号4为复购；客户3历史线下购买不影响线上首购。首购两笔净额5000分，客单价2500分；复购两笔2500分，客单价1250分。两组各2人但实际共3人。原企业结果首购1272笔，复购5610笔，不能将两个组的客户数直接相加，也不能仅凭客单价判断营销效果。

mergedConcepts.explanation: 客单价以订单数为分母；人均净额以去重客户为分母，商品行数不可替代。

mergeExamples.label: 历史订单顺序
mergeExamples.explanation: 每客户历史线上订单按日期及编号排列；注意编号1在报告期之外仍参与排名。
mergeExamples.sql:
WITH v_order_net(order_id,customer_id,channel,order_date,net_cents) AS (
 SELECT 1,1,'online','2024-12-20',1000 UNION ALL
 SELECT 2,1,'online','2025-01-02',1500 UNION ALL
 SELECT 3,2,'online','2025-01-03',2000 UNION ALL
 SELECT 4,2,'online','2025-01-03',1000 UNION ALL
 SELECT 5,3,'online','2025-02-01',3000 UNION ALL
 SELECT 6,3,'store','2024-01-01',500
), a AS (
 SELECT *,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY order_date,order_id) rn
 FROM v_order_net WHERE channel='online'
)
SELECT order_id,customer_id,rn FROM a ORDER BY order_id

mergeExamples.label: 报告期订单与标签
mergeExamples.explanation: 过滤年份后再分类；客户2在两个订单组均出现。
mergeExamples.sql:
WITH v_order_net(order_id,customer_id,channel,order_date,net_cents) AS (
 SELECT 1,1,'online','2024-12-20',1000 UNION ALL
 SELECT 2,1,'online','2025-01-02',1500 UNION ALL
 SELECT 3,2,'online','2025-01-03',2000 UNION ALL
 SELECT 4,2,'online','2025-01-03',1000 UNION ALL
 SELECT 5,3,'online','2025-02-01',3000 UNION ALL
 SELECT 6,3,'store','2024-01-01',500
), a AS (
 SELECT *,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY order_date,order_id) rn
 FROM v_order_net WHERE channel='online'
)
SELECT order_id,customer_id,CASE WHEN rn=1 THEN 'new' ELSE 'returning' END segment FROM a WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' ORDER BY order_id

mergeExamples.label: 完整收入与客单价
mergeExamples.explanation: 在订单粒度计算两个组的指标。
mergeExamples.sql:
WITH v_order_net(order_id,customer_id,channel,order_date,net_cents) AS (
 SELECT 1,1,'online','2024-12-20',1000 UNION ALL
 SELECT 2,1,'online','2025-01-02',1500 UNION ALL
 SELECT 3,2,'online','2025-01-03',2000 UNION ALL
 SELECT 4,2,'online','2025-01-03',1000 UNION ALL
 SELECT 5,3,'online','2025-02-01',3000 UNION ALL
 SELECT 6,3,'store','2024-01-01',500
), a AS (
 SELECT *,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY order_date,order_id) rn
 FROM v_order_net WHERE channel='online'
)
SELECT CASE WHEN rn=1 THEN 'new' ELSE 'returning' END segment,
 COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) customers,COUNT(*) orders,SUM(net_cents) net_cents,
 ROUND(1.0*SUM(net_cents)/COUNT(*),2) avg_order_cents
FROM a WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY CASE WHEN rn=1 THEN 'new' ELSE 'returning' END ORDER BY segment

mergeExamples.label: 验证客户数不可相加
mergeExamples.explanation: 报告期独立去重客户共3人。
mergeExamples.sql:
WITH v_order_net(order_id,customer_id,channel,order_date,net_cents) AS (
 SELECT 1,1,'online','2024-12-20',1000 UNION ALL
 SELECT 2,1,'online','2025-01-02',1500 UNION ALL
 SELECT 3,2,'online','2025-01-03',2000 UNION ALL
 SELECT 4,2,'online','2025-01-03',1000 UNION ALL
 SELECT 5,3,'online','2025-02-01',3000 UNION ALL
 SELECT 6,3,'store','2024-01-01',500
), a AS (
 SELECT *,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY order_date,order_id) rn
 FROM v_order_net WHERE channel='online'
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) unique_customers FROM a WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'

title: 客户消费分层
learningObjective: 能够从订单汇总最近消费、频率和金额，分别评分并解释分层。
concept: 最近消费距截止日越短通常代表近期活跃；频率是订单数，金额为期间净额。三个指标属于不同量纲，先各自分档再加总，不能把天数、次数和金额直接相加。五等分按排序后的行数分配，不是固定金额区间；并列值可能因客户编号被分到不同组。
useCase: 2025年有有效线上订单的客户；截止2025-12-31；一客户一行。按最后消费日期、订单数、净额分别降序并用客户编号决胜。5分最高，总分至少13为高价值，至多6为低活跃，其余常规。原企业日期维度以2023-01-01为索引0，2025-12-31索引1095；其他数据集不可直接套常数。
comparison: 固定消费阈值利于跨期比较；相对五等分利于本期相对比较。样本少于五人时未必出现全部档位。

commonError.example: 按距上次消费天数降序直接赋高分，或将并列五等分当作同名次。
commonError.correction: 最近日期降序或距截止日天数升序；按业务要求选择五等分或并列排名。

teaching.problem: 2025年有有效线上订单的客户；截止2025-12-31；一客户一行。按最后消费日期、订单数、净额分别降序并用客户编号决胜。5分最高，总分至少13为高价值，至多6为低活跃，其余常规。原企业日期维度以2023-01-01为索引0，2025-12-31索引1095；其他数据集不可直接套常数。
teaching.codeExplanation: MAX 取最后一单日期，COUNT(*) 在订单粒度数订单，SUM 汇总金额。NTILE(5) 从第一档到第五档分配行，6减档号使高排名得高分。最后通过日期维度换算距截止日天数；独立教学查询以 julianday 计算相同日期差。固定阈值分档用 CASE；保留同金额名次用 DENSE_RANK，评分和排名不混为一谈。
teaching.resultExplanation: 小型五人样例：客户1最近当天消费、两次共8000分，三项均5分；客户2得12分而非高价值；客户4、5分别6、3分属于低活跃。这只是演示分档，五人过少不能据此判断真实客户价值。原企业客户12距截止日20天，分数4、3、3总计10，为常规；分层取决于样本与规则，不能认定低活跃就是流失或高价值就是高利润。

mergedConcepts.explanation: 固定金额分层采用互斥阈值，明确等值边界及缺失。
客户净额先汇总再排名；同额同名次时只按金额排名，最终展示另加客户编号。

mergeExamples.label: 客户三项指标
mergeExamples.explanation: 最近日期、订单数、净额均先聚合到客户粒度。
mergeExamples.sql:
WITH v_order_net(customer_id,order_date,net_cents,channel) AS (
 SELECT 1,'2025-12-31',5000,'online' UNION ALL SELECT 1,'2025-12-20',3000,'online' UNION ALL

title: 客户留存与同期群分析
learningObjective: 能够识别首购月份、构造观察期、按客户去重计算留存率及次月留存。
concept: 同期群是按共同起点划分的一组客户，本题起点为历史首购月份。第0月为首购月；第1月为下一自然月，不是首购后30天。每期留存率=该同期群当月购买的去重客户数÷首购群原始人数。各月分别计算，因此不要求连续活跃，客户中途不买后再次购买仍可计入当月留存。
useCase: 线上有效订单，历史首购月份确定同期群；观察截止2025-12-31，月偏移0至6。一同期群×月偏移一行。已观察而无购买记0，未来未观察月份不展示；分母沿用同期群初始人数。
executionSteps: 去重统计每月活跃客户
comparison: 次月留存是特定同期群的偏移1，与年度复购率不同；月活跃人数不是订单数。

commonError.example: 把分母换成上月活跃人数，或把未来月份填零。
commonError.correction: 始终保留首购群规模；使用截至观察日的月份轴；按客户去重。

teaching.problem: 线上有效订单，历史首购月份确定同期群；观察截止2025-12-31，月偏移0至6。一同期群×月偏移一行。已观察而无购买记0，未来未观察月份不展示；分母沿用同期群初始人数。
teaching.codeExplanation: a 用 MIN 得首购月份，b 按同期群数客户；m 从日历抽取完整月份；x 将同期群与月份交叉连接，仅保留不早于首购且不晚于截止月的组合，月偏移=年份差×12+月份差。y 将订单连接首购群，再按群和月去重客户。最终用 x 左连接 y，缺交易且已观察的月份填0。原生数据库转换整数用 SIGNED，本地示例用 INTEGER。
teaching.resultExplanation: 9月首购群2人，10月客户1有两笔订单但只算1人，次月留存50%；11月0%，12月客户1回来为50%，说明本口径不是连续留存。12月群在样例中只有第0月，不能填未来月份0%。原企业2023年1月群7人，次月4人留存57.14%，第三个观察月2人28.57%；不同群应比较相同偏移并确认观察窗口。

mergedConcepts.explanation: 次月留存取偏移1，分母为首购月群规模；同客户次月多单仍只计一人。

mergeExamples.explanation: 客户1、2首购在9月，客户3在10月，客户4在12月。
mergeExamples.sql:
WITH v_order_net(customer_id,order_date,channel) AS (
 SELECT 1,'2025-09-01','online' UNION ALL SELECT 1,'2025-10-01','online' UNION ALL SELECT 1,'2025-10-05','online' UNION ALL SELECT 1,'2025-12-01','online' UNION ALL
 SELECT 2,'2025-09-02','online' UNION ALL SELECT 3,'2025-10-03','online' UNION ALL SELECT 3,'2025-12-02','online' UNION ALL SELECT 4,'2025-12-03','online'
), calendar_days(day,month_key) AS (SELECT '2025-09-01','2025-09' UNION ALL SELECT '2025-10-01','2025-10' UNION ALL SELECT '2025-11-01','2025-11' UNION ALL SELECT '2025-12-01','2025-12'),
a AS (SELECT customer_id,MIN(SUBSTR(order_date,1,7)) cohort FROM v_order_net WHERE channel='online' GROUP BY customer_id),
b AS (SELECT cohort,COUNT(*) n FROM a GROUP BY cohort),
m AS (SELECT DISTINCT month_key FROM calendar_days WHERE day<='2025-12-31'),
x AS (SELECT b.cohort,m.month_key,b.n,(CAST(SUBSTR(m.month_key,1,4) AS INTEGER)-CAST(SUBSTR(b.cohort,1,4) AS INTEGER))*12+CAST(SUBSTR(m.month_key,6,2) AS INTEGER)-CAST(SUBSTR(b.cohort,6,2) AS INTEGER) k FROM b CROSS JOIN m WHERE m.month_key>=b.cohort),

title: 预算与实际费用差异
learningObjective: 能够按部门及费用科目计算预算偏差，并识别超支与预算遗漏。
concept: 预算是计划值，实际费用是已入账费用净额。冲销应保留负号。差额=实际−预算；偏差率=差额÷预算×100%。先统一期间、科目与部门粒度，否则明细连接会成倍放大金额。
useCase: 财务主管检查2025年预算执行。每部门每科目一行，以预算为保留侧；无发生额视作零的前提是账务来源完整。超过预算110%才标记，恰好110%不标记；零预算的偏差率为空，但正实际费用仍触发标记。无预算实际费用另行检查。
comparison: 年度差额可抵消各月超支；费用偏差不是收入偏差，正差额通常代表超支。

commonError.example: 按部门直接连接预算月行和实际凭证行后求和，或用 ABS 汇总费用。
commonError.correction: 先分别按相同粒度汇总，保留冲销方向；另行查无预算费用。

teaching.problem: 财务主管检查2025年预算执行。每部门每科目一行，以预算为保留侧；无发生额视作零的前提是账务来源完整。超过预算110%才标记，恰好110%不标记；零预算的偏差率为空，但正实际费用仍触发标记。无预算实际费用另行检查。
teaching.codeExplanation: SUM 分别汇总两种事实；LEFT JOIN 使用两个维度键；COALESCE 只处理没有匹配的实际汇总；NULLIF 防止零分母；CASE 采用严格大于条件。按月分析时两侧都加月份键，不能只对一侧加月份。
teaching.resultExplanation: 部门1科目1实际23000、预算20000，超支15%；科目2无费用，差额−5000。部门2科目1零预算发生200，偏差率不可定义但应关注；科目2恰好110%不标记。部门3无预算实际400未进入主报表，需补充异常清单。企业预览部门1科目1偏差58.6%，不能凭此认定浪费。

mergedConcepts.explanation: 按会计科目和期间归集费用，保留冲销方向。
月报必须保留双方月份键，年度先统一汇总粒度。

mergeExamples.explanation: 每个部门科目一行。
mergeExamples.sql:
WITH budgets(department_id,account_id,month_key,budget_cents) AS (
 SELECT 1,1,'2025-01',10000 UNION ALL SELECT 1,1,'2025-02',10000
 UNION ALL SELECT 1,2,'2025-01',5000 UNION ALL SELECT 2,1,'2025-01',0
 UNION ALL SELECT 2,2,'2025-01',10000
), v_expenses(department_id,account_id,entry_date,expense_cents) AS (
 SELECT 1,1,'2025-01-10',13000 UNION ALL SELECT 1,1,'2025-02-10',11000
 UNION ALL SELECT 1,1,'2025-02-15',-1000 UNION ALL SELECT 2,1,'2025-01-10',200
 UNION ALL SELECT 2,2,'2025-01-10',11000 UNION ALL SELECT 3,1,'2025-01-10',400
) SELECT department_id,account_id,SUM(budget_cents) budget FROM budgets GROUP BY department_id,account_id ORDER BY 1,2

 UNION ALL SELECT 1,2,'2025-01',5000 UNION ALL SELECT 2,1,'2025-01',0
 UNION ALL SELECT 2,2,'2025-01',10000
), v_expenses(department_id,account_id,entry_date,expense_cents) AS (
 SELECT 1,1,'2025-01-10',13000 UNION ALL SELECT 1,1,'2025-02-10',11000
 UNION ALL SELECT 1,1,'2025-02-15',-1000 UNION ALL SELECT 2,1,'2025-01-10',200

mergeExamples.explanation: 保留预算清单，零预算及严格超支边界。
mergeExamples.sql:
WITH budgets(department_id,account_id,month_key,budget_cents) AS (
 SELECT 1,1,'2025-01',10000 UNION ALL SELECT 1,1,'2025-02',10000
 UNION ALL SELECT 1,2,'2025-01',5000 UNION ALL SELECT 2,1,'2025-01',0
 UNION ALL SELECT 2,2,'2025-01',10000
), v_expenses(department_id,account_id,entry_date,expense_cents) AS (
 SELECT 1,1,'2025-01-10',13000 UNION ALL SELECT 1,1,'2025-02-10',11000
 UNION ALL SELECT 1,1,'2025-02-15',-1000 UNION ALL SELECT 2,1,'2025-01-10',200
 UNION ALL SELECT 2,2,'2025-01-10',11000 UNION ALL SELECT 3,1,'2025-01-10',400
), b AS (SELECT department_id,account_id,SUM(budget_cents) budget FROM budgets WHERE month_key BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-12' GROUP BY department_id,account_id), a AS (SELECT department_id,account_id,SUM(expense_cents) actual FROM v_expenses WHERE entry_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY department_id,account_id) SELECT b.department_id,b.account_id,b.budget budget_cents,COALESCE(a.actual,0) actual_cents,COALESCE(a.actual,0)-b.budget variance_cents,ROUND(100.0*(COALESCE(a.actual,0)-b.budget)/NULLIF(b.budget,0),2) variance_pct,CASE WHEN COALESCE(a.actual,0)>b.budget*1.1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END over_budget FROM b LEFT JOIN a ON a.department_id=b.department_id AND a.account_id=b.account_id ORDER BY b.department_id,b.account_id

mergeExamples.explanation: 反存在判断找到主报表未覆盖的组合。
mergeExamples.sql:
WITH budgets(department_id,account_id,month_key,budget_cents) AS (
 SELECT 1,1,'2025-01',10000 UNION ALL SELECT 1,1,'2025-02',10000
 UNION ALL SELECT 1,2,'2025-01',5000 UNION ALL SELECT 2,1,'2025-01',0
 UNION ALL SELECT 2,2,'2025-01',10000
), v_expenses(department_id,account_id,entry_date,expense_cents) AS (
 SELECT 1,1,'2025-01-10',13000 UNION ALL SELECT 1,1,'2025-02-10',11000
 UNION ALL SELECT 1,1,'2025-02-15',-1000 UNION ALL SELECT 2,1,'2025-01-10',200
 UNION ALL SELECT 2,2,'2025-01-10',11000 UNION ALL SELECT 3,1,'2025-01-10',400
) SELECT a.department_id,a.account_id,SUM(a.expense_cents) actual FROM v_expenses a WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM budgets b WHERE b.department_id=a.department_id AND b.account_id=a.account_id) GROUP BY a.department_id,a.account_id ORDER BY 1,2

title: 供应商发票与付款核对
learningObjective: 能够按发票核对净应付、截止日前付款及余额，并区分四种付款状态。
concept: 净应付=原始面额−截至截止日已批准贷项；余额=净应付−已付金额。已结清不等于一定付现，贷项可能抵销全部面额。发票与付款通常一对多，贷项也是独立明细，直接连接会形成乘积。
useCase: 财务应付人员核对截至2025-12-31的发票。原视图已包含截止日规则；示例用独立付款及贷项汇总复现其含义。金额为马币分。原状态规则先判余额为零，再判付款为零，之后判断余额正负。若允许贷项超过面额且无付款，应单独审核负余额分类。
comparison: 采购订单金额核对按采购订单粒度；付款核对按发票粒度。余额不等于原始面额减所有历史付款。

commonError.example: 把付款与贷项明细直接连接后累计，或使用付款日超过截止日的记录。
commonError.correction: 独立预聚合并统一截止日；保留贷项审批状态及原始面额供审计。

teaching.problem: 财务应付人员核对截至2025-12-31的发票。原视图已包含截止日规则；示例用独立付款及贷项汇总复现其含义。金额为马币分。原状态规则先判余额为零，再判付款为零，之后判断余额正负。若允许贷项超过面额且无付款，应单独审核负余额分类。
teaching.codeExplanation: 先按发票编号 GROUP BY 两组明细；LEFT JOIN 保留无付款或无贷项的发票；COALESCE 将不存在的汇总记录视为零。CASE 按顺序判断状态，不能先判付款为零，否则全额贷项抵销会被误报为未付。
teaching.resultExplanation: 发票1面额10000、贷项2000、已付5000，余额3000；跨年付款不计。发票2未付5000；发票3已结清；发票4多付500；发票5全额贷项抵销，没有现金付款仍结清。原企业预览发票252余额1095304分，需结合到期日判断紧急程度。

mergedConcepts.explanation: 采购订单与发票行应分别汇总到采购订单粒度再比较金额，不把付款粒度混入。

mergeExamples.label: 批准贷项
mergeExamples.explanation: 排除未批准贷项。

mergeExamples.label: 截止日前付款
mergeExamples.explanation: 发票1两笔付款合计5000，跨年付款排除。

mergeExamples.label: 完整付款核对
mergeExamples.explanation: 保留所有发票，识别四种状态。

mergeExamples.label: 采购订单金额核对
mergeExamples.explanation: 独立汇总采购行与发票行，避免两行乘两行。
mergeExamples.sql: WITH po(id,amount) AS (SELECT 1,6000 UNION ALL SELECT 1,4000), inv(id,amount) AS (SELECT 1,3000 UNION ALL SELECT 1,5000), a AS (SELECT id,SUM(amount) ordered FROM po GROUP BY id), b AS (SELECT id,SUM(amount) billed FROM inv GROUP BY id) SELECT a.id,ordered,billed,billed-ordered difference FROM a JOIN b ON a.id=b.id

title: 应付账款账龄
learningObjective: 能够计算截止日逾期天数，以未结清余额制作供应商账龄报表。
concept: 账龄按合同到期日而非发票开立日计算；截至报告日尚未到期的项目归入未逾期。只统计正余额；部分付款只统计剩余金额。各账龄区间必须互斥且覆盖所有有效到期日。
useCase: 2025-12-31为固定截止日；到期当日未逾期，1至30、31至60、61至90、超过90日分别分组。金额使用截止日前批准贷项和付款后的余额。假设到期日非空且有效；缺失日期应单独审核，不能照搬原 CASE 的默认分组。
comparison: 付款状态说明是否结清；账龄说明未结清余额的逾期程度。历史账龄不能使用今天的付款余额倒推。

commonError.example: 以发票面额代替余额，使用当前日期替代历史截止日，或把第90天重复归入两个区间。
commonError.correction: 锁定截止日及净余额，明确每个区间端点；缺失到期日单独检查。

teaching.problem: 2025-12-31为固定截止日；到期当日未逾期，1至30、31至60、61至90、超过90日分别分组。金额使用截止日前批准贷项和付款后的余额。假设到期日非空且有效；缺失日期应单独审核，不能照搬原 CASE 的默认分组。
teaching.codeExplanation: CASE 从未逾期向较早到期日判断。固定日期边界等价于日期差的整数区间；SQLite 教学用 julianday 验证边界，原生 MySQL 可用 DATEDIFF。COUNT(*) 仅在每发票一行时表示发票数；SUM(balance_cents) 汇总未付金额。
teaching.resultExplanation: 12月1日恰好逾期30天，11月30日为31天；11月1日为60天，10月31日为61天；10月2日为90天，10月1日为91天。供应商1的61至90天余额11000；未来到期的8000归未逾期；零余额及超付不进入应付账龄。原输出标签90+实际指超过90日，不包括第90天。

mergedConcepts.explanation: 部分付款及截止日后付款的处理：仅扣截止日前有效付款，账龄计剩余未付额。

mergeExamples.label: 日期差边界
mergeExamples.explanation: 先验证逐张发票的逾期天数，未来到期为负值。
mergeExamples.sql:
WITH v_invoice_balance(supplier_invoice_id,supplier_id,due_date,balance_cents) AS (
 SELECT 1,1,'2025-12-31',1000 UNION ALL SELECT 2,1,'2025-12-01',2000
 UNION ALL SELECT 3,1,'2025-11-30',3000 UNION ALL SELECT 4,1,'2025-11-01',4000
 UNION ALL SELECT 5,1,'2025-10-31',5000 UNION ALL SELECT 6,1,'2025-10-02',6000
 UNION ALL SELECT 7,1,'2025-10-01',7000 UNION ALL SELECT 8,2,'2026-01-15',8000
 UNION ALL SELECT 9,2,'2025-10-01',0 UNION ALL SELECT 10,2,'2025-10-01',-100
) SELECT supplier_invoice_id,CAST(julianday('2025-12-31')-julianday(due_date) AS INTEGER) days FROM v_invoice_balance WHERE balance_cents>0 ORDER BY supplier_invoice_id

mergeExamples.label: 逐笔账龄分类
mergeExamples.explanation: 分桶之前筛正余额。
mergeExamples.sql:
WITH v_invoice_balance(supplier_invoice_id,supplier_id,due_date,balance_cents) AS (
 SELECT 1,1,'2025-12-31',1000 UNION ALL SELECT 2,1,'2025-12-01',2000
 UNION ALL SELECT 3,1,'2025-11-30',3000 UNION ALL SELECT 4,1,'2025-11-01',4000
 UNION ALL SELECT 5,1,'2025-10-31',5000 UNION ALL SELECT 6,1,'2025-10-02',6000
 UNION ALL SELECT 7,1,'2025-10-01',7000 UNION ALL SELECT 8,2,'2026-01-15',8000
 UNION ALL SELECT 9,2,'2025-10-01',0 UNION ALL SELECT 10,2,'2025-10-01',-100
), a AS (SELECT v.*,CASE WHEN due_date>='2025-12-31' THEN 'current' WHEN due_date>='2025-12-01' THEN '01-30' WHEN due_date>='2025-11-01' THEN '31-60' WHEN due_date>='2025-10-02' THEN '61-90' ELSE '90+' END bucket FROM v_invoice_balance v WHERE balance_cents>0) SELECT supplier_invoice_id,bucket,balance_cents FROM a ORDER BY supplier_invoice_id

mergeExamples.label: 完整账龄报表
mergeExamples.explanation: 按供应商和分桶汇总。
mergeExamples.sql:
WITH v_invoice_balance(supplier_invoice_id,supplier_id,due_date,balance_cents) AS (
 SELECT 1,1,'2025-12-31',1000 UNION ALL SELECT 2,1,'2025-12-01',2000
 UNION ALL SELECT 3,1,'2025-11-30',3000 UNION ALL SELECT 4,1,'2025-11-01',4000
 UNION ALL SELECT 5,1,'2025-10-31',5000 UNION ALL SELECT 6,1,'2025-10-02',6000
 UNION ALL SELECT 7,1,'2025-10-01',7000 UNION ALL SELECT 8,2,'2026-01-15',8000
 UNION ALL SELECT 9,2,'2025-10-01',0 UNION ALL SELECT 10,2,'2025-10-01',-100
), a AS (SELECT v.*,CASE WHEN due_date>='2025-12-31' THEN 'current' WHEN due_date>='2025-12-01' THEN '01-30' WHEN due_date>='2025-11-01' THEN '31-60' WHEN due_date>='2025-10-02' THEN '61-90' ELSE '90+' END bucket FROM v_invoice_balance v WHERE balance_cents>0) SELECT supplier_id,bucket,COUNT(*) invoices,SUM(balance_cents) outstanding_cents FROM a GROUP BY supplier_id,bucket ORDER BY supplier_id,bucket

mergeExamples.label: 截止日前部分付款
mergeExamples.explanation: 同一发票跨年付款不减少报告期余额。
mergeExamples.sql: WITH invoice(id,amount) AS (SELECT 1,10000), pay(id,day,amount) AS (SELECT 1,'2025-12-20',3000 UNION ALL SELECT 1,'2026-01-02',7000), p AS (SELECT id,SUM(amount) paid FROM pay WHERE day<='2025-12-31' GROUP BY id) SELECT i.id,i.amount-COALESCE(p.paid,0) balance FROM invoice i LEFT JOIN p ON p.id=i.id

title: 银行流水与凭证对账
learningObjective: 能在统一期间汇总双方金额，识别单侧缺失及金额差异。
concept: 银行原始支出为负，净支出取负号后求和；退款冲回减少净支出。每真实参考号一行，无参考号银行行按独立编号保留。差额=银行净支出−账簿费用。
useCase: 财务人员核对2025年费用凭证与银行交易。先匹配参考号再回查单据，不以金额相等代替匹配。
comparison: 金额相同不是同笔交易的充分证据；时间差也不等于漏记。

commonError.example: 逐笔取绝对值并只做内连接。
commonError.correction: 按带符号金额汇总，使用全量键及缺失类型。

teaching.problem: 财务人员核对2025年费用凭证与银行交易。先匹配参考号再回查单据，不以金额相等代替匹配。
teaching.codeExplanation: a 按真实凭证号汇总，b 按参考号及缺失类型汇总。k 用 UNION 保留双方全部键；两个 LEFT JOIN 保留单侧记录。缺失侧金额保持空值，仅计算差额时补零。合成显示名不是连接键，类型标识参与连接，避免真实 BANK-4 与银行编号4碰撞。
teaching.resultExplanation: A 的1000支出及100退款合为900，与账簿一致；B 仅账簿500，C 银行600与账簿700差−100；D 仅银行300。两个无编号银行行各自保留。真实 BANK-4 已匹配，合成 BANK-4 仍独立。

mergeExamples.label: 凭证净额
mergeExamples.explanation: A 的冲销减少费用。
mergeExamples.sql:
WITH v_expenses(reference_no,entry_date,expense_cents) AS (VALUES ('A','2025-01-01',1000),('A','2025-01-02',-100),('B','2025-02-01',500),('C','2025-03-01',700),('BANK-4','2025-01-01',200)),
bank_transactions(bank_id,reference_no,transaction_date,amount_cents) AS (VALUES (1,'A','2025-01-01',-1000),(2,'A','2025-01-02',100),(3,'C','2025-03-01',-600),(4,NULL,'2025-01-01',-80),(5,'D','2025-02-01',-300),(6,'BANK-4','2025-01-01',-200),(7,NULL,'2025-02-01',-20)),
a AS (SELECT 0 unreferenced,reference_no ref,SUM(expense_cents) ledger FROM v_expenses WHERE entry_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY reference_no) SELECT ref,ledger FROM a ORDER BY ref

mergeExamples.label: 银行净支出
mergeExamples.explanation: 退款为正流水，转为负支出；空号独立分组。
mergeExamples.sql:
WITH v_expenses(reference_no,entry_date,expense_cents) AS (VALUES ('A','2025-01-01',1000),('A','2025-01-02',-100),('B','2025-02-01',500),('C','2025-03-01',700),('BANK-4','2025-01-01',200)),
bank_transactions(bank_id,reference_no,transaction_date,amount_cents) AS (VALUES (1,'A','2025-01-01',-1000),(2,'A','2025-01-02',100),(3,'C','2025-03-01',-600),(4,NULL,'2025-01-01',-80),(5,'D','2025-02-01',-300),(6,'BANK-4','2025-01-01',-200),(7,NULL,'2025-02-01',-20)),
b AS (SELECT CASE WHEN reference_no IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END unreferenced,COALESCE(reference_no,CAST(bank_id AS CHAR)) ref,SUM(-amount_cents) bank FROM bank_transactions WHERE transaction_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY CASE WHEN reference_no IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,COALESCE(reference_no,CAST(bank_id AS CHAR))) SELECT unreferenced,ref,bank FROM b ORDER BY 1,2

mergeExamples.label: 完整对账
mergeExamples.explanation: 保留单侧及金额不符，已匹配的记录不输出。
mergeExamples.sql:
WITH v_expenses(reference_no,entry_date,expense_cents) AS (VALUES ('A','2025-01-01',1000),('A','2025-01-02',-100),('B','2025-02-01',500),('C','2025-03-01',700),('BANK-4','2025-01-01',200)),
bank_transactions(bank_id,reference_no,transaction_date,amount_cents) AS (VALUES (1,'A','2025-01-01',-1000),(2,'A','2025-01-02',100),(3,'C','2025-03-01',-600),(4,NULL,'2025-01-01',-80),(5,'D','2025-02-01',-300),(6,'BANK-4','2025-01-01',-200),(7,NULL,'2025-02-01',-20)),
a AS (SELECT 0 unreferenced,reference_no ref,SUM(expense_cents) ledger FROM v_expenses WHERE entry_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY reference_no),
b AS (SELECT CASE WHEN reference_no IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END unreferenced,COALESCE(reference_no,CAST(bank_id AS CHAR)) ref,SUM(-amount_cents) bank FROM bank_transactions WHERE transaction_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY CASE WHEN reference_no IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,COALESCE(reference_no,CAST(bank_id AS CHAR))),
k AS (SELECT unreferenced,ref FROM a UNION SELECT unreferenced,ref FROM b)
SELECT CASE WHEN k.unreferenced=1 THEN 'BANK-'||k.ref ELSE k.ref END ref,a.ledger ledger_cents,b.bank bank_cents,COALESCE(b.bank,0)-COALESCE(a.ledger,0) difference_cents,CASE WHEN a.ref IS NULL THEN 'bank_only' WHEN b.ref IS NULL THEN 'ledger_only' ELSE 'difference' END issue,CASE WHEN k.unreferenced=1 THEN 'unreferenced_bank' ELSE 'reference' END reference_kind FROM k LEFT JOIN a ON a.ref=k.ref AND a.unreferenced=k.unreferenced LEFT JOIN b ON b.ref=k.ref AND b.unreferenced=k.unreferenced WHERE a.ref IS NULL OR b.ref IS NULL OR a.ledger<>b.bank ORDER BY ref,reference_kind

mergeExamples.label: 同显示名不同键
mergeExamples.explanation: 真实 BANK-4 和合成 BANK-4 不得合并。
mergeExamples.sql:
WITH v_expenses(reference_no,entry_date,expense_cents) AS (VALUES ('A','2025-01-01',1000),('A','2025-01-02',-100),('B','2025-02-01',500),('C','2025-03-01',700),('BANK-4','2025-01-01',200)),
bank_transactions(bank_id,reference_no,transaction_date,amount_cents) AS (VALUES (1,'A','2025-01-01',-1000),(2,'A','2025-01-02',100),(3,'C','2025-03-01',-600),(4,NULL,'2025-01-01',-80),(5,'D','2025-02-01',-300),(6,'BANK-4','2025-01-01',-200),(7,NULL,'2025-02-01',-20)),
a AS (SELECT 0 unreferenced,reference_no ref,SUM(expense_cents) ledger FROM v_expenses WHERE entry_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY reference_no),
b AS (SELECT CASE WHEN reference_no IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END unreferenced,COALESCE(reference_no,CAST(bank_id AS CHAR)) ref,SUM(-amount_cents) bank FROM bank_transactions WHERE transaction_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY CASE WHEN reference_no IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,COALESCE(reference_no,CAST(bank_id AS CHAR))),
k AS (SELECT unreferenced,ref FROM a UNION SELECT unreferenced,ref FROM b) SELECT unreferenced,ref FROM k WHERE ref IN ('BANK-4','4') ORDER BY 1

title: 多规则异常交易筛查
learningObjective: 能按发票粒度计算四项独立规则，并建立可追溯复核清单。
concept: 截至2025年底，重复=同供应商同发票号多张；大额=原始面额严格超过供应商期间内面额均值两倍；超付=净应付减实付小于零；价格差=原面额与本次开票数量按采购单价重算金额的绝对差超过100分。
useCase: 审计人员优先复核同时命中多项规则的发票，不能将规则当成违规证据。
comparison: 价格差不等于数量超收；大额基准应在同一可比群体计算。

commonError.example: 将第四项解释成关联缺失，或把所有异常写在一个互斥 CASE。
commonError.correction: 用同一票的采购重算金额作价格比较，四项分别标记。

teaching.problem: 审计人员优先复核同时命中多项规则的发票，不能将规则当成违规证据。
teaching.codeExplanation: f 按发票汇总数量乘单价，采购价也乘同一开票数量。a 窗口计重复次数及供应商面额均值，不能先筛大额再算均值。z 四个 CASE 独立计算，最后相加并筛选。净应付含批准贷项，面额不冲减贷项。
teaching.resultExplanation: 供应商1平均面额325；发票3面额1000超过650，预期800，差200，净余额−50，共三项。发票1、2同号各触发重复；发票5与跨供应商同号不算重复，价格差恰100不触发。

mergedConcepts.explanation: 金额阈值应说明期间、收支方向及可比群体；一次性支出可能合理。
保留命中原因、原始单据及口径；逐笔复核后才定性。

mergeExamples.label: 票面与采购价重算
mergeExamples.explanation: 发票3开票2件，分别乘500与400。
mergeExamples.sql:
WITH supplier_invoice_items(supplier_invoice_id,po_item_id,quantity_billed,unit_price_cents) AS (VALUES (1,1,1,100),(2,2,1,100),(3,3,2,500),(4,4,1,100),(5,5,1,200)),
purchase_order_items(po_item_id,unit_price_cents) AS (VALUES (1,100),(2,100),(3,400),(4,100),(5,100)),
v_invoice_balance(supplier_invoice_id,supplier_id,invoice_no,billed_cents,balance_cents) AS (VALUES (1,1,'X',100,100),(2,1,'X',100,0),(3,1,'Y',900,-50),(4,1,'Z',100,100),(5,2,'X',200,200)),
f AS (SELECT x.supplier_invoice_id,SUM(x.quantity_billed*x.unit_price_cents) face,SUM(x.quantity_billed*p.unit_price_cents) expected FROM supplier_invoice_items x JOIN purchase_order_items p ON p.po_item_id=x.po_item_id GROUP BY x.supplier_invoice_id) SELECT * FROM f ORDER BY 1

mergeExamples.label: 供应商比较基准
mergeExamples.explanation: 重复按供应商及编号，均值按供应商。
mergeExamples.sql:
WITH supplier_invoice_items(supplier_invoice_id,po_item_id,quantity_billed,unit_price_cents) AS (VALUES (1,1,1,100),(2,2,1,100),(3,3,2,500),(4,4,1,100),(5,5,1,200)),
purchase_order_items(po_item_id,unit_price_cents) AS (VALUES (1,100),(2,100),(3,400),(4,100),(5,100)),
v_invoice_balance(supplier_invoice_id,supplier_id,invoice_no,billed_cents,balance_cents) AS (VALUES (1,1,'X',100,100),(2,1,'X',100,0),(3,1,'Y',900,-50),(4,1,'Z',100,100),(5,2,'X',200,200)),
f AS (SELECT x.supplier_invoice_id,SUM(x.quantity_billed*x.unit_price_cents) face,SUM(x.quantity_billed*p.unit_price_cents) expected FROM supplier_invoice_items x JOIN purchase_order_items p ON p.po_item_id=x.po_item_id GROUP BY x.supplier_invoice_id),a AS (SELECT v.*,f.face,f.expected,COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY supplier_id,invoice_no) copies,AVG(f.face) OVER(PARTITION BY supplier_id) avg_bill FROM v_invoice_balance v JOIN f ON f.supplier_invoice_id=v.supplier_invoice_id) SELECT supplier_invoice_id,copies,avg_bill FROM a ORDER BY 1

mergeExamples.label: 完整异常筛查
mergeExamples.explanation: 三个命中规则的发票优先，正常项不输出。
mergeExamples.sql:
WITH supplier_invoice_items(supplier_invoice_id,po_item_id,quantity_billed,unit_price_cents) AS (VALUES (1,1,1,100),(2,2,1,100),(3,3,2,500),(4,4,1,100),(5,5,1,200)),
purchase_order_items(po_item_id,unit_price_cents) AS (VALUES (1,100),(2,100),(3,400),(4,100),(5,100)),
v_invoice_balance(supplier_invoice_id,supplier_id,invoice_no,billed_cents,balance_cents) AS (VALUES (1,1,'X',100,100),(2,1,'X',100,0),(3,1,'Y',900,-50),(4,1,'Z',100,100),(5,2,'X',200,200)),
f AS (SELECT x.supplier_invoice_id,SUM(x.quantity_billed*x.unit_price_cents) face,SUM(x.quantity_billed*p.unit_price_cents) expected FROM supplier_invoice_items x JOIN purchase_order_items p ON p.po_item_id=x.po_item_id GROUP BY x.supplier_invoice_id),a AS (SELECT v.*,f.face,f.expected,COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY supplier_id,invoice_no) copies,AVG(f.face) OVER(PARTITION BY supplier_id) avg_bill FROM v_invoice_balance v JOIN f ON f.supplier_invoice_id=v.supplier_invoice_id),z AS (SELECT a.*,CASE WHEN copies>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END duplicate_flag,CASE WHEN face>2*avg_bill THEN 1 ELSE 0 END large_flag,CASE WHEN balance_cents<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END overpay_flag,CASE WHEN ABS(face-expected)>100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END mismatch_flag FROM a) SELECT supplier_invoice_id,supplier_id,billed_cents,duplicate_flag,large_flag,overpay_flag,mismatch_flag,duplicate_flag+large_flag+overpay_flag+mismatch_flag flags FROM z WHERE duplicate_flag+large_flag+overpay_flag+mismatch_flag>0 ORDER BY flags DESC,supplier_invoice_id

title: 人员规模变动与离职率
learningObjective: 能按部门月份确定期初期末人数、真实离职事件及滚动比率。
concept: 任职区间左闭右开：开始日计在职，结束日不计。期初取月首日前一天，期末取月末当天。月离职率=离职人数÷期初期末平均人数；本题滚动三月率=三月离职总数÷三月平均人数之和，不是三个月累计离职率。
useCase: 人资主管比较部门人员流动；调岗只改变任职部门，不代表企业离职。保留2024年11、12月历史用于2025年1月滚动计算。
comparison: 部门净变化不等于离职人数；滚动月均口径与累计期间离职率不同。

commonError.example: 先筛2025年再开窗口，或把任职结束视为离职。
commonError.correction: 保留历史月份，结合真实终止日期确认离职。

teaching.problem: 人资主管比较部门人员流动；调岗只改变任职部门，不代表企业离职。保留2024年11、12月历史用于2025年1月滚动计算。
teaching.codeExplanation: m 取得每月首末日；a 通过部门与月份交叉连接保留空部门，按任职区间判断在职。真实离职要求员工终止日期在当月且任职结束日等于终止日。b 计算两端均值；z 按部门窗口累加人数基数和离职数，最后外层只输出2025年。
teaching.resultExplanation: 部门1十一月期初2期末3，十二月3到2且离职1；一月期初2期末2，员工3调至部门2、员工4入职，真实离职0。三个月平均人数之和7，滚动率14.29%；部门2一月期末1，部门3无员工，零基数比率为空。

mergedConcepts.explanation: 指定日在职需开始日≤该日且结束日为空或晚于当日。
真实离职数除以期初期末平均在职人数；调岗不计离职。
月末规模差用本月末减上月末，跨年保留历史基线。

mergeExamples.label: 月首月末边界
mergeExamples.explanation: 简化日历只记录所需边界。
mergeExamples.sql:
WITH calendar_days(day,month_key,day_index) AS (VALUES ('2024-11-01','2024-11',1),('2024-11-30','2024-11',30),('2024-12-01','2024-12',31),('2024-12-31','2024-12',61),('2025-01-01','2025-01',62),('2025-01-31','2025-01',92)),
