m AS (SELECT month_key,MIN(day) first_day,MAX(day) last_day,MIN(day_index) first_idx FROM calendar_days WHERE month_key BETWEEN '2024-11' AND '2025-12' GROUP BY month_key) SELECT month_key,first_day,last_day FROM m ORDER BY 1

mergeExamples.label: 部门人数及离职
mergeExamples.explanation: 部门1月初当天调岗仍属于上月末在职。
mergeExamples.sql:
WITH calendar_days(day,month_key,day_index) AS (VALUES ('2024-11-01','2024-11',1),('2024-11-30','2024-11',30),('2024-12-01','2024-12',31),('2024-12-31','2024-12',61),('2025-01-01','2025-01',62),('2025-01-31','2025-01',92)),
departments(department_id) AS (VALUES (1),(2),(3)),
employees(employee_id,termination_date) AS (VALUES (1,NULL),(2,'2024-12-15'),(3,NULL),(4,NULL)),
employment_history(employee_id,department_id,start_date,end_date) AS (VALUES (1,1,'2024-10-01',NULL),(2,1,'2024-10-01','2024-12-15'),(3,1,'2024-11-01','2025-01-01'),(3,2,'2025-01-01',NULL),(4,1,'2025-01-15',NULL)),
m AS (SELECT month_key,MIN(day) first_day,MAX(day) last_day,MIN(day_index) first_idx FROM calendar_days WHERE month_key BETWEEN '2024-11' AND '2025-12' GROUP BY month_key),a AS (SELECT d.department_id,m.month_key,SUM(CASE WHEN h.start_date<m.first_day AND (h.end_date IS NULL OR h.end_date>=m.first_day) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) opening,SUM(CASE WHEN h.start_date<=m.last_day AND (h.end_date IS NULL OR h.end_date>m.last_day) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) closing,SUM(CASE WHEN e.termination_date BETWEEN m.first_day AND m.last_day AND h.end_date=e.termination_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) exits FROM departments d CROSS JOIN m LEFT JOIN employment_history h ON h.department_id=d.department_id LEFT JOIN employees e ON e.employee_id=h.employee_id GROUP BY d.department_id,m.month_key) SELECT * FROM a ORDER BY 1,2

mergeExamples.label: 完整滚动离职率
mergeExamples.explanation: 第一个报告月包含前两月历史。
mergeExamples.sql:
WITH calendar_days(day,month_key,day_index) AS (VALUES ('2024-11-01','2024-11',1),('2024-11-30','2024-11',30),('2024-12-01','2024-12',31),('2024-12-31','2024-12',61),('2025-01-01','2025-01',62),('2025-01-31','2025-01',92)),
departments(department_id) AS (VALUES (1),(2),(3)),
employees(employee_id,termination_date) AS (VALUES (1,NULL),(2,'2024-12-15'),(3,NULL),(4,NULL)),
employment_history(employee_id,department_id,start_date,end_date) AS (VALUES (1,1,'2024-10-01',NULL),(2,1,'2024-10-01','2024-12-15'),(3,1,'2024-11-01','2025-01-01'),(3,2,'2025-01-01',NULL),(4,1,'2025-01-15',NULL)),
m AS (SELECT month_key,MIN(day) first_day,MAX(day) last_day,MIN(day_index) first_idx FROM calendar_days WHERE month_key BETWEEN '2024-11' AND '2025-12' GROUP BY month_key),a AS (SELECT d.department_id,m.month_key,SUM(CASE WHEN h.start_date<m.first_day AND (h.end_date IS NULL OR h.end_date>=m.first_day) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) opening,SUM(CASE WHEN h.start_date<=m.last_day AND (h.end_date IS NULL OR h.end_date>m.last_day) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) closing,SUM(CASE WHEN e.termination_date BETWEEN m.first_day AND m.last_day AND h.end_date=e.termination_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) exits FROM departments d CROSS JOIN m LEFT JOIN employment_history h ON h.department_id=d.department_id LEFT JOIN employees e ON e.employee_id=h.employee_id GROUP BY d.department_id,m.month_key),b AS (SELECT *,(opening+closing)/2.0 avg_h FROM a),z AS (SELECT *,SUM(exits) OVER(PARTITION BY department_id ORDER BY month_key ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) e3,SUM(avg_h) OVER(PARTITION BY department_id ORDER BY month_key ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) h3,COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY department_id ORDER BY month_key ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) n3 FROM b) SELECT department_id,month_key,opening,closing,exits,ROUND(100.0*exits/NULLIF(avg_h,0),2) exit_pct,CASE WHEN n3=3 THEN ROUND(100.0*e3/NULLIF(h3,0),2) ELSE NULL END rolling_pct FROM z WHERE month_key BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-12' ORDER BY department_id,month_key

mergeExamples.label: 月末规模净变化
mergeExamples.explanation: 先计算历史窗口，再筛一月。
mergeExamples.sql:
WITH calendar_days(day,month_key,day_index) AS (VALUES ('2024-11-01','2024-11',1),('2024-11-30','2024-11',30),('2024-12-01','2024-12',31),('2024-12-31','2024-12',61),('2025-01-01','2025-01',62),('2025-01-31','2025-01',92)),
departments(department_id) AS (VALUES (1),(2),(3)),
employees(employee_id,termination_date) AS (VALUES (1,NULL),(2,'2024-12-15'),(3,NULL),(4,NULL)),
employment_history(employee_id,department_id,start_date,end_date) AS (VALUES (1,1,'2024-10-01',NULL),(2,1,'2024-10-01','2024-12-15'),(3,1,'2024-11-01','2025-01-01'),(3,2,'2025-01-01',NULL),(4,1,'2025-01-15',NULL)),
m AS (SELECT month_key,MIN(day) first_day,MAX(day) last_day,MIN(day_index) first_idx FROM calendar_days WHERE month_key BETWEEN '2024-11' AND '2025-12' GROUP BY month_key),a AS (SELECT d.department_id,m.month_key,SUM(CASE WHEN h.start_date<m.first_day AND (h.end_date IS NULL OR h.end_date>=m.first_day) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) opening,SUM(CASE WHEN h.start_date<=m.last_day AND (h.end_date IS NULL OR h.end_date>m.last_day) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) closing,SUM(CASE WHEN e.termination_date BETWEEN m.first_day AND m.last_day AND h.end_date=e.termination_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) exits FROM departments d CROSS JOIN m LEFT JOIN employment_history h ON h.department_id=d.department_id LEFT JOIN employees e ON e.employee_id=h.employee_id GROUP BY d.department_id,m.month_key), delta AS (SELECT department_id,month_key,closing-LAG(closing) OVER(PARTITION BY department_id ORDER BY month_key) net_change FROM a) SELECT department_id,net_change FROM delta WHERE month_key='2025-01' ORDER BY 1

title: 采购成本与价格差异
learningObjective: 能够在采购行粒度比较合同与历史单价，并计算采购承诺金额及跨供应商加权价格。
concept: 合同差价衡量履约价格偏离，历史变动率衡量同供应商同商品的成交价波动。承诺成本=订购数量×成交单价；加权单价=总采购金额÷总订购量。历史基准须在报告期过滤前计算。
executionSteps: 连接采购行、订单及合同
排除取消订单并取得历史价格
计算合同差价及历史变动率
useCase: 采购分析师需要找出成交价格偏离合同或历史价格的采购行，并评估供应商比价机会。所有金额以马币分表示；采购承诺不是已收货或已付款金额。
comparison: 合同差价不是采购总成本差额；跨供应商比较需统一商品规格与成本口径。

commonError.example: 先筛2025年再用 LAG，或直接平均各次采购单价。
commonError.correction: 保留历史后计算窗口；按总金额除以总数量计算加权价。

teaching.problem: 采购分析师需要找出成交价格偏离合同或历史价格的采购行，并评估供应商比价机会。所有金额以马币分表示；采购承诺不是已收货或已付款金额。
teaching.codeExplanation: 原企业查询先连接采购行、采购订单及合同，排除取消订单。窗口按供应商和商品分区，以订单日期及行编号确定先后；这样同日多行仍有稳定顺序。先取历史上一行，再筛2025年，避免第一笔年度采购丢失上年基准。合同差价=成交单价−合同单价；历史变动率=(成交单价−上一采购行单价)/上一采购行单价×100，分母为零或缺失时留空。跨供应商比较采用数量加权价，先汇总金额与数量，不能直接平均单价。采购承诺金额采用已批准的订购数量×成交单价；不同的审批状态需按业务规则分别处理。
teaching.resultExplanation: 小型示例中第2行成交120分，合同110分，差10分；较上一行100分上涨20%。第3行90分，较合同低20分，较上一行下降25%。供应商2首次采购无历史基准，不等于涨幅0%。供应商1商品10的加权价为(20×120+10×90)/30=110分，供应商2为100分，溢价10%。应进一步核查同规格、币种、税费、运费和采购批量。原企业结果前3行分别为采购行2、3、4；第2行合同差为0但历史涨幅6.52%，说明两个基准回答不同问题。企业结果为原仓库预览，本次未重跑。

mergedConcepts.explanation: 采购承诺按有效审批采购行订购量乘成交单价计算，不能混入取消及未批准订单；收货、开票、付款各自统计。
按商品供应商汇总总金额和数量计算加权单价，至少两家可比供应商才计算相对最低价的溢价，最低价为零时留空。

mergeExamples.label: 历史价格基准
mergeExamples.explanation: 先排除取消行，再在同供应商同商品内按日期和编号取上一行。
mergeExamples.sql:
WITH purchase_lines(id,supplier_id,product_id,order_date,qty,price,contract_price,status) AS (
 VALUES (1,1,10,'2024-12-20',10,100,100,'approved'),
 (2,1,10,'2025-01-05',20,120,110,'approved'),
 (3,1,10,'2025-02-05',10,90,110,'approved'),
 (4,2,10,'2025-01-06',30,100,100,'approved'),
 (5,1,10,'2025-01-10',99,500,110,'cancelled'),
 (6,2,20,'2025-02-03',5,200,200,'approved')
), valid AS (SELECT * FROM purchase_lines WHERE status<>'cancelled'), history AS (SELECT *, LAG(price) OVER(PARTITION BY supplier_id,product_id ORDER BY order_date,id) previous_price FROM valid) SELECT id,price,previous_price FROM history ORDER BY id

mergeExamples.label: 完整价格差异
mergeExamples.explanation: 保留历史后才筛选2025年，比较合同与历史两个不同基准。
mergeExamples.sql:
WITH purchase_lines(id,supplier_id,product_id,order_date,qty,price,contract_price,status) AS (
 VALUES (1,1,10,'2024-12-20',10,100,100,'approved'),
 (2,1,10,'2025-01-05',20,120,110,'approved'),
 (3,1,10,'2025-02-05',10,90,110,'approved'),
 (4,2,10,'2025-01-06',30,100,100,'approved'),
 (5,1,10,'2025-01-10',99,500,110,'cancelled'),
 (6,2,20,'2025-02-03',5,200,200,'approved')
), valid AS (SELECT * FROM purchase_lines WHERE status<>'cancelled'), history AS (SELECT *, LAG(price) OVER(PARTITION BY supplier_id,product_id ORDER BY order_date,id) previous_price FROM valid) SELECT id,price,contract_price,price-contract_price AS variance,previous_price,ROUND(100.0*(price-previous_price)/NULLIF(previous_price,0),2) AS change_pct FROM history WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' ORDER BY id

mergeExamples.label: 采购承诺成本
mergeExamples.explanation: 以有效且已批准的订购数量乘成交单价，金额单位为分。
mergeExamples.sql:
WITH purchase_lines(id,supplier_id,product_id,order_date,qty,price,contract_price,status) AS (
 VALUES (1,1,10,'2024-12-20',10,100,100,'approved'),
 (2,1,10,'2025-01-05',20,120,110,'approved'),
 (3,1,10,'2025-02-05',10,90,110,'approved'),
 (4,2,10,'2025-01-06',30,100,100,'approved'),
 (5,1,10,'2025-01-10',99,500,110,'cancelled'),
 (6,2,20,'2025-02-03',5,200,200,'approved')
), valid AS (SELECT * FROM purchase_lines WHERE status<>'cancelled') SELECT supplier_id,SUM(qty*price) AS committed_cents FROM valid WHERE status='approved' AND order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY supplier_id ORDER BY supplier_id

mergeExamples.label: 跨供应商加权比价
mergeExamples.explanation: 先按商品供应商汇总，再比较至少两家供应商的商品；保留未舍入的价格计算溢价。
mergeExamples.sql:
WITH purchase_lines(id,supplier_id,product_id,order_date,qty,price,contract_price,status) AS (
 VALUES (1,1,10,'2024-12-20',10,100,100,'approved'),
 (2,1,10,'2025-01-05',20,120,110,'approved'),
 (3,1,10,'2025-02-05',10,90,110,'approved'),
 (4,2,10,'2025-01-06',30,100,100,'approved'),
 (5,1,10,'2025-01-10',99,500,110,'cancelled'),
 (6,2,20,'2025-02-03',5,200,200,'approved')
), valid AS (SELECT * FROM purchase_lines WHERE status<>'cancelled'), w AS (SELECT product_id,supplier_id,1.0*SUM(qty*price)/NULLIF(SUM(qty),0) weighted_price FROM valid WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY product_id,supplier_id), b AS (SELECT *,MIN(weighted_price) OVER(PARTITION BY product_id) cheapest,COUNT(weighted_price) OVER(PARTITION BY product_id) suppliers FROM w) SELECT product_id,supplier_id,ROUND(weighted_price,2) weighted_price,ROUND(100.0*(weighted_price-cheapest)/NULLIF(cheapest,0),2) premium_pct FROM b WHERE suppliers>=2 ORDER BY product_id,supplier_id

title: 供应商履约率与交付表现
learningObjective: 能够按采购行与供应商计算准时足量率、完整交付率、质量合格率，并定位逾期及未到齐记录。
concept: 采购行是履约计数单位，收货件数是质量计量单位。准时足量率=承诺日及之前累计合格数量达到订购量的采购行数÷到期采购行数；完整交付率=截至年底累计合格数量达到订购量的采购行数÷到期采购行数；质量合格率=合格件数÷实际收货件数。分批收货不能按收货单数计履约；零实收时质量率留空。
executionSteps: 按采购行累计合格与实收数量
按供应商计算三项比率
useCase: 采购主管希望比较各供应商是否按承诺日期交足合格商品、截至年底是否最终交齐，以及到货质量是否稳定。统计2025年承诺到期的非取消采购行，截止2025-12-31；尚未到期的采购行不进入分母。
comparison: 准时率与完整率按采购行计数；质量率按件数加权；到齐日期不同于首次收货日期。

commonError.example: 仅统计有收货的采购行，或将首次收货日期视作到齐日期。
commonError.correction: 保留无收货行，累计合格件数至订购量并核对承诺日期。

teaching.problem: 采购主管希望比较各供应商是否按承诺日期交足合格商品、截至年底是否最终交齐，以及到货质量是否稳定。统计2025年承诺到期的非取消采购行，截止2025-12-31；尚未到期的采购行不进入分母。
teaching.codeExplanation: 原主查询使用已汇总至采购行的 v_po_lines，按承诺日期选择2025年到期采购行。每行的 on_time 是承诺日前（含当日）合格件数，accepted 是截止日合格件数，received 是截止日实收件数。用 CASE 产生0或1，再按供应商汇总；两项交付率以 COUNT(*) 为分母，质量率用合格总件数除以实收总件数，不平均各行质量率。构造该视图时，先把收货按采购行汇总，无收货以零计；截止日条件放在左连接或收货汇总内部，不能在外层 WHERE 删除无收货行。到齐日期先按日合计合格数量，再累计并取第一次达到订购量的日期。未到齐保留空日期，逾期以截止日减承诺日；提前到齐按零天处理。独立例子假设所有采购行均有效且到期、收货数量及合格数量非负。
teaching.resultExplanation: 教学数据中供应商1有3条到期行，仅第1行准时足量，准时率1÷3=33.33%；第1和第2行最终交齐，完整率2÷3=66.67%；实收21件、合格20件，质量率95.24%。供应商2有2条到期行，准时和完整率均为50%，实收8件全部合格，质量率100%。质量好不代表没有交付延误。第2行迟5天到齐；第3、5行截止日未到齐，逾期11天。原企业结果供应商1共53条到期行，准时49.06%、完整86.79%、质量99.86%；这些为原结果预览，未在本次重新执行。应结合订单规模、缺货影响和拒收原因判断改善优先级。

mergedConcepts.explanation: 一条采购行可有多次收货，先汇总实收和合格件数；无收货行仍保留。
到期有效采购行为分母，承诺日前含当日累计合格量达到订购量才算准时足量；不是首次到货即准时。
同日收货先汇总，累计合格量首次达到订购量时为到齐日期；未到齐留空，以截止日计算逾期。

mergeExamples.label: 分批收货汇总
mergeExamples.explanation: 截止日限制放在左连接条件中，保留无收货记录。第一行实收11件，合格10件；第二行承诺日前仅合格4件。
mergeExamples.sql:
WITH purchase_lines(line_id,supplier_id,ordered,promised) AS (
 VALUES (1,1,10,'2025-12-10'),(2,1,10,'2025-12-10'),(3,1,5,'2025-12-20'),(4,2,8,'2025-12-20'),(5,2,4,'2025-12-20')
), receipts(line_id,receipt_date,received,accepted) AS (
 VALUES (1,'2025-12-05',6,6),(1,'2025-12-10',5,4),(2,'2025-12-09',4,4),(2,'2025-12-15',6,6),(4,'2025-12-20',8,8),(5,'2026-01-02',4,4)
), totals AS (
 SELECT p.line_id,p.supplier_id,p.ordered,p.promised,
 COALESCE(SUM(r.received),0) received,COALESCE(SUM(r.accepted),0) accepted,
 COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.receipt_date<=p.promised THEN r.accepted ELSE 0 END),0) on_time
 FROM purchase_lines p LEFT JOIN receipts r ON r.line_id=p.line_id AND r.receipt_date<='2025-12-31'
 GROUP BY p.line_id,p.supplier_id,p.ordered,p.promised
) SELECT line_id,ordered,received,accepted,on_time FROM totals ORDER BY line_id

mergeExamples.label: 逐行判断履约
mergeExamples.explanation: 分别判断准时足量和截止日完整，迟到但最终到齐属于完整而非准时。
mergeExamples.sql:
WITH purchase_lines(line_id,supplier_id,ordered,promised) AS (
 VALUES (1,1,10,'2025-12-10'),(2,1,10,'2025-12-10'),(3,1,5,'2025-12-20'),(4,2,8,'2025-12-20'),(5,2,4,'2025-12-20')
), receipts(line_id,receipt_date,received,accepted) AS (
 VALUES (1,'2025-12-05',6,6),(1,'2025-12-10',5,4),(2,'2025-12-09',4,4),(2,'2025-12-15',6,6),(4,'2025-12-20',8,8),(5,'2026-01-02',4,4)
), totals AS (
 SELECT p.line_id,p.supplier_id,p.ordered,p.promised,
 COALESCE(SUM(r.received),0) received,COALESCE(SUM(r.accepted),0) accepted,
 COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.receipt_date<=p.promised THEN r.accepted ELSE 0 END),0) on_time
 FROM purchase_lines p LEFT JOIN receipts r ON r.line_id=p.line_id AND r.receipt_date<='2025-12-31'
 GROUP BY p.line_id,p.supplier_id,p.ordered,p.promised
) SELECT line_id,CASE WHEN on_time>=ordered THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS timely,CASE WHEN accepted>=ordered THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS complete FROM totals ORDER BY line_id

mergeExamples.label: 完整供应商履约报表
mergeExamples.explanation: 行数作为两项履约率的分母，质量合格率使用实际收货件数。
mergeExamples.sql:
WITH purchase_lines(line_id,supplier_id,ordered,promised) AS (
 VALUES (1,1,10,'2025-12-10'),(2,1,10,'2025-12-10'),(3,1,5,'2025-12-20'),(4,2,8,'2025-12-20'),(5,2,4,'2025-12-20')
), receipts(line_id,receipt_date,received,accepted) AS (
 VALUES (1,'2025-12-05',6,6),(1,'2025-12-10',5,4),(2,'2025-12-09',4,4),(2,'2025-12-15',6,6),(4,'2025-12-20',8,8),(5,'2026-01-02',4,4)
), totals AS (
 SELECT p.line_id,p.supplier_id,p.ordered,p.promised,
 COALESCE(SUM(r.received),0) received,COALESCE(SUM(r.accepted),0) accepted,
 COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.receipt_date<=p.promised THEN r.accepted ELSE 0 END),0) on_time
 FROM purchase_lines p LEFT JOIN receipts r ON r.line_id=p.line_id AND r.receipt_date<='2025-12-31'
 GROUP BY p.line_id,p.supplier_id,p.ordered,p.promised
) SELECT supplier_id,COUNT(*) due_lines,
 ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN on_time>=ordered THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),2) ontime_pct,
 ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN accepted>=ordered THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),2) complete_pct,
 ROUND(100.0*SUM(accepted)/NULLIF(SUM(received),0),2) quality_pct
 FROM totals GROUP BY supplier_id ORDER BY supplier_id

mergeExamples.label: 到齐日期与逾期天数
mergeExamples.explanation: 先按日聚合，再累计合格件数；未到齐以截止日计算逾期。准时到齐显示零天。

title: 采购、收货与发票三方核对
learningObjective: 能够按采购行预聚合收货及开票数量，构建三方差异报表，并按收货记录核对库存入库量。
concept: 三方核对比较订购数量、合格收货数量、原始开票数量及金额。应核金额=合格收货量×采购单价；金额差=原始开票金额−应核金额。数量不等或金额差非零均需复核，金额单位为分。后续贷项不在本题冲减。
executionSteps: 左连接并计算应核金额
useCase: 采购主管需在2025年末逐采购行识别少收、超开票、未开票及金额异常。采购行是连接键；只纳入2025年非取消采购行，发票截止2025-12-31。
comparison: 三方核对检查订购、合格收货与原始开票；库存核对检查合格收货是否正确入库；付款核对检查净应付及实付。

commonError.example: 直接连接多笔收货与多张发票后汇总，或只检查金额差。
commonError.correction: 按采购行预聚合，数量与金额分别检查。

teaching.problem: 采购主管需在2025年末逐采购行识别少收、超开票、未开票及金额异常。采购行是连接键；只纳入2025年非取消采购行，发票截止2025-12-31。
teaching.codeExplanation: 原主查询从已汇总的 v_po_lines 获取采购与合格收货信息；billed 将截止日前发票行按采购行分别合计数量和数量乘实际开票单价的金额，checked 左连接保证未开票仍保留，缺失开票量及金额补零。最终用三个 OR 条件识别差异，因此金额一致也可能存在数量异常。不能把收货明细和发票明细直接连接，否则多对多会放大金额。应核金额采用合格量而非订购量；原始开票金额不扣贷项，净应付另见财务核对。补充库存核对以收货记录为键，先汇总关联入库流水，再比较合格接收量；无流水且全部拒收是正常情况。独立示例仅检查已有收货记录对应的流水，孤立流水需另做反向检查。
teaching.resultExplanation: 教学数据中第2行订8收7票7，金额差0但仍需复核；第3行订5收0票0（次年发票不计），金额差0仍有少收；第4行订4收4票5，多开100分；第5行订2收2票2但开票单价550分高于采购500分，差100分。第1行两批收货和两张发票完全一致，不出现。库存核对示例第12号少入库1件，第41号少4件；第31号全部拒收且无入库不异常。原企业预览采购行4订77收0票0，行22订8收7票7，行23订13收13票15、金额差5628分。原企业数据未在本次重新执行。差异可能源于在途、分批交付或价格录入，不能直接定性。

mergedConcepts.explanation: 按收货记录核对合格接收量与实际入库流水量；全部拒收保留，应入库为零；无差异是有效结论。

mergeExamples.label: 合格收货汇总
mergeExamples.explanation: 按采购行合计合格件数；第3行全部拒收，合格量为零。
mergeExamples.sql:
WITH po(id,ordered,price) AS (VALUES (1,10,100),(2,8,200),(3,5,300),(4,4,100),(5,2,500)),
receipts(rid,id,accepted,day) AS (VALUES (11,1,6,'2025-12-01'),(12,1,4,'2025-12-02'),(21,2,7,'2025-12-03'),(31,3,0,'2025-12-04'),(41,4,4,'2025-12-05'),(51,5,2,'2025-12-06')),
invoices(id,qty,price,day) AS (VALUES (1,6,100,'2025-12-01'),(1,4,100,'2025-12-03'),(2,7,200,'2025-12-05'),(4,5,100,'2025-12-06'),(5,2,550,'2025-12-07'),(3,5,300,'2026-01-01')),
r AS (SELECT id,SUM(accepted) accepted FROM receipts WHERE day<='2025-12-31' GROUP BY id),
b AS (SELECT id,SUM(qty) billed,SUM(qty*price) billed_cents FROM invoices WHERE day<='2025-12-31' GROUP BY id),
c AS (SELECT po.id,ordered,COALESCE(r.accepted,0) accepted,COALESCE(b.billed,0) billed,COALESCE(b.billed_cents,0) billed_cents,COALESCE(r.accepted,0)*po.price expected_cents FROM po LEFT JOIN r ON r.id=po.id LEFT JOIN b ON b.id=po.id)
SELECT * FROM r ORDER BY id;

mergeExamples.label: 开票汇总
mergeExamples.explanation: 只累计截止日及以前的原始发票行，第3行次年开票不计入。
mergeExamples.sql:
WITH po(id,ordered,price) AS (VALUES (1,10,100),(2,8,200),(3,5,300),(4,4,100),(5,2,500)),
receipts(rid,id,accepted,day) AS (VALUES (11,1,6,'2025-12-01'),(12,1,4,'2025-12-02'),(21,2,7,'2025-12-03'),(31,3,0,'2025-12-04'),(41,4,4,'2025-12-05'),(51,5,2,'2025-12-06')),
invoices(id,qty,price,day) AS (VALUES (1,6,100,'2025-12-01'),(1,4,100,'2025-12-03'),(2,7,200,'2025-12-05'),(4,5,100,'2025-12-06'),(5,2,550,'2025-12-07'),(3,5,300,'2026-01-01')),
r AS (SELECT id,SUM(accepted) accepted FROM receipts WHERE day<='2025-12-31' GROUP BY id),
b AS (SELECT id,SUM(qty) billed,SUM(qty*price) billed_cents FROM invoices WHERE day<='2025-12-31' GROUP BY id),
c AS (SELECT po.id,ordered,COALESCE(r.accepted,0) accepted,COALESCE(b.billed,0) billed,COALESCE(b.billed_cents,0) billed_cents,COALESCE(r.accepted,0)*po.price expected_cents FROM po LEFT JOIN r ON r.id=po.id LEFT JOIN b ON b.id=po.id)
SELECT * FROM b ORDER BY id;

mergeExamples.label: 完整三方核对
mergeExamples.explanation: 第2行少收一件但金额一致；第3行未合格收货亦未开票；第4行多开一件；第5行数量一致但价格偏高。第1行完全匹配，不输出。
mergeExamples.sql:
WITH po(id,ordered,price) AS (VALUES (1,10,100),(2,8,200),(3,5,300),(4,4,100),(5,2,500)),
receipts(rid,id,accepted,day) AS (VALUES (11,1,6,'2025-12-01'),(12,1,4,'2025-12-02'),(21,2,7,'2025-12-03'),(31,3,0,'2025-12-04'),(41,4,4,'2025-12-05'),(51,5,2,'2025-12-06')),
invoices(id,qty,price,day) AS (VALUES (1,6,100,'2025-12-01'),(1,4,100,'2025-12-03'),(2,7,200,'2025-12-05'),(4,5,100,'2025-12-06'),(5,2,550,'2025-12-07'),(3,5,300,'2026-01-01')),
r AS (SELECT id,SUM(accepted) accepted FROM receipts WHERE day<='2025-12-31' GROUP BY id),
b AS (SELECT id,SUM(qty) billed,SUM(qty*price) billed_cents FROM invoices WHERE day<='2025-12-31' GROUP BY id),
c AS (SELECT po.id,ordered,COALESCE(r.accepted,0) accepted,COALESCE(b.billed,0) billed,COALESCE(b.billed_cents,0) billed_cents,COALESCE(r.accepted,0)*po.price expected_cents FROM po LEFT JOIN r ON r.id=po.id LEFT JOIN b ON b.id=po.id)
SELECT *,billed_cents-expected_cents variance_cents FROM c WHERE ordered<>accepted OR accepted<>billed OR billed_cents<>expected_cents ORDER BY id;

mergeExamples.label: 收货与库存流水核对
mergeExamples.explanation: 按收货记录编号汇总入库，全部拒收且无入库视为正常；第12号少入库一件，第41号未入库。
mergeExamples.sql: WITH receipts(rid,accepted) AS (VALUES (11,6),(12,4),(31,0),(41,4)), movements(rid,qty) AS (VALUES (11,2),(11,4),(12,3)), m AS (SELECT rid,SUM(qty) qty FROM movements GROUP BY rid) SELECT r.rid,r.accepted,COALESCE(m.qty,0) stocked,COALESCE(m.qty,0)-r.accepted difference FROM receipts r LEFT JOIN m ON m.rid=r.rid WHERE COALESCE(m.qty,0)<>r.accepted ORDER BY r.rid;

title: 多表汇总与贡献率
learningObjective: 能够按指定业务粒度计算净销售贡献率，保留无销售门店，并解释全体分母与零分母边界。
concept: 贡献率=分组净销售额÷全部分组净销售额×100%。分母必须与分子采用相同期间、渠道及有效订单口径。先按门店汇总，再计算全体总额；全体为零时比例留空。净销售可能因退款为负，贡献率并不必然介于0%和100%之间。
syntax: SUM(金额) OVER()；分组金额 / NULLIF(总体金额,0)
executionSteps: 限定有效线下订单及期间
保留门店并汇总净销售
计算全体净销售及贡献率
useCase: 区域经理需要比较2025年全部实体门店对同期净销售的贡献，并保留没有销售的门店。金额采用马币分；有效订单以原项目视图为准。
comparison: 贡献率以总体净销售为分母；毛利率以本组净销售为分母；排名只表示顺序，并非比例。

commonError.example: 先筛选前三门店再计算总体，或将右表过滤放在 WHERE。
commonError.correction: 先计算所有门店贡献率再筛名次；右表匹配条件放在 ON。

notes: 原课程数据、主查询和结果保持不变。独立示例采用内联净额，未重建原项目视图；原生数据库及浏览器未验证。

teaching.problem: 区域经理需要比较2025年全部实体门店对同期净销售的贡献，并保留没有销售的门店。金额采用马币分；有效订单以原项目视图为准。
teaching.codeExplanation: 原查询以门店主档为左表，将渠道和日期条件放在 ON 中，避免无匹配订单的门店被 WHERE 排除。SUM 汇总订单净额，COALESCE 将无销售的门店补零。totals 每门店一行；SUM(net_cents) OVER() 在该层每行提供相同总体分母。NULLIF 将零分母变为空，ROUND 仅在最后保留两位小数。若只展示前几名，先在公用表表达式内计算比例，再在外层排序限制行数；不能先过滤门店再计算总体。类别分析需要商品销售明细及类别映射，而非将订单总额直接连接商品明细。独立例子直接提供净额，未重新构造原订单退款视图。
teaching.resultExplanation: 主查询结果为门店1净额450分、84.91%，门店2净额80分、15.09%，门店3净额0分、0%。独立例子复现相同数值：门店1的2024年订单及门店2的线上订单排除。类别示例总额500分，前两类合计占90%，剩余10%属于未展示类别。贡献率高不代表利润率高；管理层还需结合成本和门店规模。

mergedConcepts.explanation: 商品类别贡献率同样先聚合全部类别、计算总体，再限制展示名次。订单总额不能直接分摊至多件商品；采用有效商品行净额并核对类别连接键。

mergeExamples.label: 门店净销售汇总
mergeExamples.explanation: 先将订单聚合到门店粒度；门店3没有有效订单仍保留。
mergeExamples.sql:
WITH stores(store_id) AS (VALUES (1),(2),(3)),
v_order_net(store_id,channel,order_date,net_cents) AS (VALUES
 (1,'store','2025-01-02',400),(1,'store','2025-03-02',50),
 (2,'store','2025-03-03',80),(1,'store','2024-12-31',900),
 (2,'online','2025-03-04',200)),
totals AS (
 SELECT s.store_id,COALESCE(SUM(o.net_cents),0) net_cents
 FROM stores s LEFT JOIN v_order_net o ON o.store_id=s.store_id
 AND o.channel='store' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
 GROUP BY s.store_id
)
SELECT * FROM totals ORDER BY store_id;

mergeExamples.label: 完整贡献率查询
mergeExamples.sql:
WITH stores(store_id) AS (VALUES (1),(2),(3)),
v_order_net(store_id,channel,order_date,net_cents) AS (VALUES
 (1,'store','2025-01-02',400),(1,'store','2025-03-02',50),
 (2,'store','2025-03-03',80),(1,'store','2024-12-31',900),
 (2,'online','2025-03-04',200)),
totals AS (
 SELECT s.store_id,COALESCE(SUM(o.net_cents),0) net_cents
 FROM stores s LEFT JOIN v_order_net o ON o.store_id=s.store_id
 AND o.channel='store' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
 GROUP BY s.store_id
)
SELECT store_id,net_cents,ROUND(100.0*net_cents/NULLIF(SUM(net_cents) OVER(),0),2) sales_pct
FROM totals ORDER BY net_cents DESC,store_id;

mergeExamples.label: 类别贡献率与前两名
mergeExamples.explanation: 总额500分，类别1为300分、类别2为150分，前两名仍分别占总体60%及30%，不重新归一。
mergeExamples.sql:
WITH sales(category_id,net_cents) AS (VALUES (1,200),(1,100),(2,150),(3,50)),
totals AS (SELECT category_id,SUM(net_cents) net_cents FROM sales GROUP BY category_id),
shares AS (SELECT category_id,net_cents,ROUND(100.0*net_cents/NULLIF(SUM(net_cents) OVER(),0),2) sales_pct FROM totals)
SELECT * FROM shares ORDER BY net_cents DESC,category_id LIMIT 2;

mergeExamples.label: 总体为零的边界
mergeExamples.explanation: 总体0时比例没有定义，即使单个门店为0也不能显示0%。
mergeExamples.sql: WITH totals(store_id,net_cents) AS (VALUES (1,0),(2,0)) SELECT store_id,net_cents,ROUND(100.0*net_cents/NULLIF(SUM(net_cents) OVER(),0),2) sales_pct FROM totals ORDER BY store_id;

title: 时间序列与缺失月份
learningObjective: 能够构造连续自然月报表，保留无销售月份，计算上月金额、金额差及环比，并说明缺失记录、零分母与跨年历史基准的区别。
concept: 时间序列分析先确定时间粒度及连续时间轴，再把实际业务金额汇总至相同粒度。环比=(本期金额−上一期金额)÷上一期金额×100%。上一期为零或缺失时百分比留空；上一期为零但本期有金额时，金额差仍可计算。窗口函数取的是排序后的上一行，不会自动识别缺失自然月。
syntax: LAG(金额) OVER(ORDER BY 月份)；(本期金额-上期金额)/NULLIF(上期金额,0)
executionSteps: 按月汇总有效线下订单
左连接月份并按口径补零
取得上月金额并计算变化
useCase: 经营主管需要一份2025年线下月度净销售报表，包含无销售月份、上期净销售、金额变化与环比百分比。来源数据完整才允许将无交易解释为零；系统漏传、未关账、未来月份不能直接补零。金额采用马币分。
comparison: 环比比较相邻自然月；同比比较上一年同月，连续月轴可使用偏移12行；金额差不需要除法，零基数时仍可求差。原案例没有同比历史范围。

commonError.example: 只对有销售的月份使用 LAG，或将零分母的环比补为0%。
commonError.correction: 先建立完整月份轴并核实数据完整性，再计算窗口；零分母保留 NULL，跨年报告最后筛选展示期。

notes: 原课程主查询、结果、数据来源均保留。独立示例直接内联净销售金额，未重建原订单退款视图；原生数据库及浏览器未验证。

teaching.problem: 经营主管需要一份2025年线下月度净销售报表，包含无销售月份、上期净销售、金额变化与环比百分比。来源数据完整才允许将无交易解释为零；系统漏传、未关账、未来月份不能直接补零。金额采用马币分。
teaching.codeExplanation: 原查询的 months 通过 DISTINCT 将日历日期归并成唯一月份；sales 根据日期的前 7 个字符（年-月）聚合净额，渠道及年度过滤仅作用于交易。complete 用月份轴左连接销售汇总，COALESCE 把无匹配金额补成0；若数据不完整，应另外标注缺失而非补零。previous 在月份连续且唯一的结果上按月排序取 LAG，第一行无上一行所以为空。最终金额差直接相减，百分比以 NULLIF 保护零分母，再 ROUND 保留两位。不能先删除无销售月份再使用窗口函数，也不能把金额增加理解成从零增长100%。原案例只读取2025年月份，因此1月没有历史基准；若面试要求比较2024年12月，应同时扩大日历与销售历史范围，在窗口计算之后再筛报告期。跨年示例独立展示该顺序。
teaching.resultExplanation: 主查询前3个月净额依次400、0、130分。独立内联例子复现该结果，且明确4月至12月为无交易月份。2月由400降至0，金额差−400、环比−100%；3月从0增至130，金额差130，环比为空；4月由130降至0，环比−100%；5月两个相邻月份均为0，金额差0但环比仍为空。原案例首月缺失上期，金额差及百分比均为空；跨年示例提供上年12月200分后，1月400分的环比为100%。净销售为负时数学比率仍可计算，但可能不符合常规增长解读，需单独说明退款或冲销。连续时间轴不自动证明数据完整。

mergeExamples.label: 连续月份轴
mergeExamples.explanation: 日期维度可能每日一行，先去重得到12个月。

mergeExamples.label: 月度净销售汇总
mergeExamples.explanation: 限定线下及2025年；3月两笔50和80合计130，2月线上订单不计。

mergeExamples.label: 补齐缺失月份
mergeExamples.explanation: 以月份轴为左表；在来源完整的假设下，无销售月补零。

mergeExamples.label: 完整环比报表
mergeExamples.explanation: 先补齐再取上一行。2月比1月下降100%；3月从0恢复130，百分比不可定义；5月至12月金额不变但零分母仍留空。
mergeExamples.sql:
WITH calendar_days(month_key) AS (VALUES
 ('2025-01'),('2025-01'),('2025-02'),('2025-03'),('2025-04'),('2025-05'),('2025-06'),('2025-07'),('2025-08'),('2025-09'),('2025-10'),('2025-11'),('2025-12')),
v_order_net(channel,order_date,net_cents) AS (VALUES
 ('store','2025-01-02',400),('store','2025-03-02',50),('store','2025-03-03',80),('online','2025-02-04',200),('store','2024-12-31',900)),
months AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT month_key FROM calendar_days WHERE month_key BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-12'
), sales AS (
 SELECT SUBSTR(order_date,1,7) month_key,SUM(net_cents) net_cents FROM v_order_net
 WHERE channel='store' AND order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY SUBSTR(order_date,1,7)
), complete AS (
 SELECT m.month_key,COALESCE(s.net_cents,0) net_cents FROM months m LEFT JOIN sales s ON m.month_key=s.month_key
), previous AS (
 SELECT month_key,net_cents,LAG(net_cents) OVER(ORDER BY month_key) previous_net_cents FROM complete
)
SELECT month_key,net_cents,previous_net_cents,net_cents-previous_net_cents change_cents,
 ROUND(100.0*(net_cents-previous_net_cents)/NULLIF(previous_net_cents,0),2) change_pct
FROM previous ORDER BY month_key;

mergeExamples.label: 跨年基准与报告期筛选
mergeExamples.explanation: 先保留2024年12月，再取上期，最后筛2025年。1月较上年12月增长100%；2月下降100%。
mergeExamples.sql:
WITH monthly(month_key,net_cents) AS (VALUES ('2024-12',200),('2025-01',400),('2025-02',0)),
previous AS (SELECT *,LAG(net_cents) OVER(ORDER BY month_key) previous_net_cents FROM monthly)
SELECT month_key,net_cents,previous_net_cents,net_cents-previous_net_cents change_cents,
ROUND(100.0*(net_cents-previous_net_cents)/NULLIF(previous_net_cents,0),2) change_pct
FROM previous WHERE month_key >= '2025-01' ORDER BY month_key;

title: 分组内排名与前N名
learningObjective: 能够按业务对象汇总金额、按组独立排名，并根据是否保留并列选择排名函数，完成门店商品及部门薪酬榜单。
concept: 分组内排名先聚合到业务对象，再按所属组建立窗口，最后在外层筛名次。ROW_NUMBER 为每行分配唯一序号，RANK 同额并列且跳号，DENSE_RANK 同额并列不跳号。固定最多三行使用 ROW_NUMBER，要求前三个名次包含并列使用 RANK，要求前三种不同金额使用 DENSE_RANK。
syntax: ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY 分组键 ORDER BY 金额 DESC, 唯一键)；外层 WHERE 名次<=N
executionSteps: 外层筛前三并稳定排序
useCase: 商品经理要求2025年每店净销售为正的前三件商品，并列仍最多三件。人资案例则要求指定月份各部门薪酬前三名，允许同薪并列。两个案例的输出粒度分别是门店×商品和部门×员工，不能直接排名交易明细。金额为马币分。
comparison: 固定行数用 ROW_NUMBER；并列且跳号用 RANK；并列不跳号用 DENSE_RANK。全局排名不分区，分组排名需明确 PARTITION BY。

commonError.example: 直接对订单明细排名，或先筛前三条交易再汇总；在 RANK 窗口中加入唯一编号破坏并列。
commonError.correction: 先按业务键汇总，再分区排名和外层筛选；并列排名仅按业务指标排序，展示层再加编号。

notes: 原主查询、原数据源、结果及关联不变。独立内联数据未重建原订单退款视图；原生数据库及浏览器未验证。

teaching.problem: 商品经理要求2025年每店净销售为正的前三件商品，并列仍最多三件。人资案例则要求指定月份各部门薪酬前三名，允许同薪并列。两个案例的输出粒度分别是门店×商品和部门×员工，不能直接排名交易明细。金额为马币分。
teaching.codeExplanation: sales 在指定期间及渠道内按门店、商品汇总净销售；HAVING 排除净额不大于零的商品，不能在 WHERE 排除负金额明细，否则退货冲减会丢失。ranked 使用 PARTITION BY store_id 让每家店独立编号，ORDER BY net_cents DESC 从高到低排列，product_id 作为唯一决胜键保证同额顺序稳定。最后在外层 WHERE sales_rank<=3 筛排名，因为同层 WHERE 早于窗口计算。最终 ORDER BY 决定展示顺序，窗口内排序不能代替它。若业务要求并列，RANK 窗口中不能加入唯一商品编号，否则原本同额的商品会被拆成不同名次。部门薪酬案例先固定月份，将基本薪资及奖金汇总到员工，再按部门排名；实际数据应验证薪资组成是否重复及员工部门归属。
teaching.resultExplanation: 独立示例中门店1四件商品净额均为100分，商品1由两笔明细合计而成。固定前三名只显示商品1、2、3；保留并列时四件均为第一名。门店2只有两件有效商品，所以结果只有两行。此报表不展示没有正净销售的门店；若需要完整门店清单，应另外左连接门店主档。薪酬例中员工2基本薪资400000分与奖金20000分合计420000分，与员工3并列第二；员工4为第四名，不能进入前三名。排名仅描述金额顺序，不等于商品利润或员工绩效。

mergedConcepts.explanation: 门店商品榜先按门店商品汇总跨订单净销售，再分组排名，避免同一商品重复入榜。
部门薪酬榜固定月份、按员工汇总基本薪资与奖金，再按部门分区；同薪是否并列决定排名函数。

mergeExamples.label: 按门店商品汇总
mergeExamples.explanation: 商品1两笔60及40合计100；商品5净额为零被排除；线上及上年记录不计。
mergeExamples.sql:
WITH v_sales_lines(store_id,product_id,net_cents,channel,order_date) AS (VALUES
 (1,1,60,'store','2025-01-01'),(1,1,40,'store','2025-02-01'),
 (1,2,100,'store','2025-01-01'),(1,3,100,'store','2025-01-01'),
 (1,4,100,'store','2025-01-01'),(1,5,0,'store','2025-01-01'),
 (2,1,80,'store','2025-01-01'),(2,2,20,'store','2025-01-01'),
 (2,3,900,'online','2025-01-01'),(2,4,900,'store','2024-01-01')),
sales AS (
 SELECT store_id,product_id,SUM(net_cents) net_cents FROM v_sales_lines
 WHERE channel='store' AND order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
 GROUP BY store_id,product_id HAVING SUM(net_cents)>0
), ranked AS (
 SELECT store_id,product_id,net_cents,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY net_cents DESC,product_id) sales_rank FROM sales
)
SELECT * FROM sales ORDER BY store_id,product_id;

mergeExamples.label: 分区排名
mergeExamples.explanation: 每店重新编号；同额以商品编号决定顺序。
mergeExamples.sql:
WITH v_sales_lines(store_id,product_id,net_cents,channel,order_date) AS (VALUES
 (1,1,60,'store','2025-01-01'),(1,1,40,'store','2025-02-01'),
 (1,2,100,'store','2025-01-01'),(1,3,100,'store','2025-01-01'),
 (1,4,100,'store','2025-01-01'),(1,5,0,'store','2025-01-01'),
 (2,1,80,'store','2025-01-01'),(2,2,20,'store','2025-01-01'),
 (2,3,900,'online','2025-01-01'),(2,4,900,'store','2024-01-01')),
sales AS (
 SELECT store_id,product_id,SUM(net_cents) net_cents FROM v_sales_lines
 WHERE channel='store' AND order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
 GROUP BY store_id,product_id HAVING SUM(net_cents)>0
), ranked AS (
 SELECT store_id,product_id,net_cents,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY net_cents DESC,product_id) sales_rank FROM sales
)
SELECT * FROM ranked ORDER BY store_id,sales_rank;

mergeExamples.label: 完整前三名报表
mergeExamples.explanation: 外层筛选排名不超过3；门店1同额四件只保留三件，门店2仅两件。
mergeExamples.sql:
WITH v_sales_lines(store_id,product_id,net_cents,channel,order_date) AS (VALUES
 (1,1,60,'store','2025-01-01'),(1,1,40,'store','2025-02-01'),
 (1,2,100,'store','2025-01-01'),(1,3,100,'store','2025-01-01'),
 (1,4,100,'store','2025-01-01'),(1,5,0,'store','2025-01-01'),
 (2,1,80,'store','2025-01-01'),(2,2,20,'store','2025-01-01'),
 (2,3,900,'online','2025-01-01'),(2,4,900,'store','2024-01-01')),
sales AS (
 SELECT store_id,product_id,SUM(net_cents) net_cents FROM v_sales_lines
 WHERE channel='store' AND order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
 GROUP BY store_id,product_id HAVING SUM(net_cents)>0
), ranked AS (
 SELECT store_id,product_id,net_cents,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY net_cents DESC,product_id) sales_rank FROM sales
)
SELECT store_id,product_id,net_cents,sales_rank FROM ranked WHERE sales_rank<=3 ORDER BY store_id,sales_rank;

mergeExamples.label: 保留并列名次
mergeExamples.explanation: 排名窗口仅按销售额排序，展示层才加商品编号。同额四件并列第一，全部入选。
mergeExamples.sql:
WITH v_sales_lines(store_id,product_id,net_cents,channel,order_date) AS (VALUES
 (1,1,60,'store','2025-01-01'),(1,1,40,'store','2025-02-01'),
 (1,2,100,'store','2025-01-01'),(1,3,100,'store','2025-01-01'),
 (1,4,100,'store','2025-01-01'),(1,5,0,'store','2025-01-01'),
 (2,1,80,'store','2025-01-01'),(2,2,20,'store','2025-01-01'),
 (2,3,900,'online','2025-01-01'),(2,4,900,'store','2024-01-01')),
sales AS (
 SELECT store_id,product_id,SUM(net_cents) net_cents FROM v_sales_lines
 WHERE channel='store' AND order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
 GROUP BY store_id,product_id HAVING SUM(net_cents)>0
), ranked AS (
 SELECT store_id,product_id,net_cents,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY net_cents DESC,product_id) sales_rank FROM sales
), tied AS (SELECT store_id,product_id,net_cents,RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY net_cents DESC) sales_rank FROM sales)
SELECT * FROM tied WHERE sales_rank<=3 ORDER BY store_id,sales_rank,product_id;

mergeExamples.label: 部门薪酬前三名
mergeExamples.explanation: 固定薪资月份并按员工累计基本薪资和奖金；假设员工当月仅属一个部门。保留并列，部门1两人同为第二，部门2独立排名。
mergeExamples.sql:
WITH payroll(department_id,employee_id,month_key,base_cents,bonus_cents) AS (VALUES
 (1,1,'2025-01',500000,50000),(1,2,'2025-01',400000,0),(1,2,'2025-01',0,20000),
 (1,3,'2025-01',420000,0),(1,4,'2025-01',300000,0),(2,5,'2025-01',200000,0),
 (1,4,'2024-12',900000,0)), totals AS (
 SELECT department_id,employee_id,SUM(base_cents+bonus_cents) pay_cents FROM payroll
 WHERE month_key='2025-01' GROUP BY department_id,employee_id), ranked AS (
 SELECT *,RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY department_id ORDER BY pay_cents DESC) pay_rank FROM totals)
SELECT * FROM ranked WHERE pay_rank<=3 ORDER BY department_id,pay_rank,employee_id;

title: 商品销售贡献与库存资金占用错配
learningObjective: 能够独立汇总商品年度净销售和期末库存成本，计算全局贡献率及百分点差，并识别分母、粒度与缺失数据风险。
concept: 销售贡献率=商品年度净销售额÷全部商品年度净销售额×100；库存占比=商品年底库存成本价值÷全部商品年底库存成本价值×100。库存价值为各仓数量×单位成本之和。错配差值=库存占比−销售贡献率，单位为百分点。销售是期间流量，库存是时点存量，不能直接相减。分母为零时保留空值；先分别汇总再连接，避免销售明细与库存快照多对多放大。
syntax: SUM(指标) OVER()；100.0*商品指标/NULLIF(全体指标,0)；库存占比−销售贡献率
executionSteps: 分别汇总年度销售与年底库存
useCase: 管理层想找出2025年度销售贡献低、年底库存资金占用却高的商品。比较所有渠道年度净销售与2025-12-31各仓库存成本价值；两项指标均以全体商品为比较总体，每商品一行。
comparison: 销售额是期间流量，库存价值是时点存量；两个占比可比较相对结构，但不能代替库存周转率或利润率。

commonError.example: 先筛有销售商品再算库存占比，或直接连接销售明细与库存快照。
commonError.correction: 分别预聚合到商品粒度，以完整商品主档为基准；先计算总体再筛选。

notes: 原企业主查询、数据源、结果引用与关联保持不变。原查询将缺少快照视作零，真实分析中需区分缺档与零库存，先检查预期仓库商品组合是否完整及快照唯一性。本节独立内联示例仅验证查询逻辑，未重建原企业视图、未验证原生数据库或浏览器。

teaching.problem: 管理层想找出2025年度销售贡献低、年底库存资金占用却高的商品。比较所有渠道年度净销售与2025-12-31各仓库存成本价值；两项指标均以全体商品为比较总体，每商品一行。
teaching.codeExplanation: a 按商品汇总2025年所有渠道有效净销售，不另设渠道限制；净额视图已定义退货口径，不再次减退款。b 只取2025-12-31快照，逐仓计算数量×单位成本再按商品求和，不能跨日期累计快照。z 以商品主档为起点，将两个已经汇总到商品粒度的结果分别左连接，按原案例将无匹配指标补0。q 用 SUM(net) OVER() 与 SUM(stock) OVER() 分别得到全局总额，不分区；每行共享全局分母，NULLIF 防止零分母。最后先用原精度份额相减，再分别舍入四位小数，按差值倒序、商品编号升序。如果只查看错配前十名，必须先计算全体份额再限制行数。独立例子假设快照覆盖完整、每仓每商品每日期唯一，并以负净额模拟销售冲减；这不是重建企业销售视图。
teaching.resultExplanation: 独立示例的总净销售及总库存均为1000分。商品3没有销售却占40%库存，差值+40个百分点，优先检查滞销或新品备货；商品2贡献20%销售却占40%库存，差值+20个百分点；商品1贡献80%销售、占20%库存，差值−60个百分点，但不能直接断定缺货。商品4两者为0且总体非零，差值为0。企业原结果中商品339销售占0.3307%、库存占2.4631%、差值2.1324个百分点；商品308无净销售、库存占1.3807%、差值1.3807个百分点。上述企业数值仅引用原预览，本次未重新运行企业数据库。正差值是筛查线索，需结合库存覆盖天数、季节备货、退货、毛利及缺货情况复核。负净销售可能使贡献率为负或超过100%，不可解释为通常的非负份额；净销售总额非正时应先审查业务口径。

mergeExamples.label: 独立汇总年度销售
mergeExamples.explanation: 所有渠道都纳入；退货冲减为负值时保留；2024年的900分排除。
mergeExamples.sql:
WITH products(product_id) AS (VALUES (1),(2),(3),(4)),
v_sales_lines(product_id,order_date,channel,net_cents) AS (VALUES
 (1,'2025-01-01','store',600),(1,'2025-02-01','online',300),(1,'2025-03-01','store',-100),
 (2,'2025-01-01','store',200),(2,'2024-12-31','store',900)),
inventory_snapshots(product_id,warehouse_id,snapshot_date,quantity,unit_cost_cents) AS (VALUES
 (1,1,'2025-12-31',2,50),(1,2,'2025-12-31',1,100),
 (2,1,'2025-12-31',4,100),(3,1,'2025-12-31',4,100),(2,1,'2024-12-31',20,100)),
a AS (SELECT product_id,SUM(net_cents) net FROM v_sales_lines WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY product_id) SELECT * FROM a ORDER BY product_id

mergeExamples.label: 独立汇总年底库存
mergeExamples.explanation: 只取年底快照，跨仓库合计数量乘成本，不使用售价。
mergeExamples.sql:
WITH products(product_id) AS (VALUES (1),(2),(3),(4)),
v_sales_lines(product_id,order_date,channel,net_cents) AS (VALUES
 (1,'2025-01-01','store',600),(1,'2025-02-01','online',300),(1,'2025-03-01','store',-100),
 (2,'2025-01-01','store',200),(2,'2024-12-31','store',900)),
inventory_snapshots(product_id,warehouse_id,snapshot_date,quantity,unit_cost_cents) AS (VALUES
 (1,1,'2025-12-31',2,50),(1,2,'2025-12-31',1,100),
 (2,1,'2025-12-31',4,100),(3,1,'2025-12-31',4,100),(2,1,'2024-12-31',20,100)),
b AS (SELECT product_id,SUM(quantity*unit_cost_cents) stock FROM inventory_snapshots WHERE snapshot_date='2025-12-31' GROUP BY product_id) SELECT * FROM b ORDER BY product_id

mergeExamples.label: 对齐商品与全局分母
mergeExamples.explanation: 以商品主档为左侧，商品3无销售仍占用库存；商品4两项均无记录，按原案例补零。
mergeExamples.sql:
WITH products(product_id) AS (VALUES (1),(2),(3),(4)),
v_sales_lines(product_id,order_date,channel,net_cents) AS (VALUES
 (1,'2025-01-01','store',600),(1,'2025-02-01','online',300),(1,'2025-03-01','store',-100),
 (2,'2025-01-01','store',200),(2,'2024-12-31','store',900)),
inventory_snapshots(product_id,warehouse_id,snapshot_date,quantity,unit_cost_cents) AS (VALUES
 (1,1,'2025-12-31',2,50),(1,2,'2025-12-31',1,100),
 (2,1,'2025-12-31',4,100),(3,1,'2025-12-31',4,100),(2,1,'2024-12-31',20,100)),
a AS (SELECT product_id,SUM(net_cents) net FROM v_sales_lines WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY product_id),
b AS (SELECT product_id,SUM(quantity*unit_cost_cents) stock FROM inventory_snapshots WHERE snapshot_date='2025-12-31' GROUP BY product_id),
z AS (SELECT p.product_id,COALESCE(a.net,0) net,COALESCE(b.stock,0) stock FROM products p LEFT JOIN a ON a.product_id=p.product_id LEFT JOIN b ON b.product_id=p.product_id),
q AS (SELECT *,100.0*net/NULLIF(SUM(net) OVER(),0) sales_share,100.0*stock/NULLIF(SUM(stock) OVER(),0) stock_share FROM z)
SELECT product_id,net,stock,SUM(net) OVER() total_net,SUM(stock) OVER() total_stock FROM z ORDER BY product_id

mergeExamples.label: 完整错配报表
mergeExamples.explanation: 分别计算全体份额，再用未舍入份额相减；正值越大表示库存份额相对销售贡献越高。
mergeExamples.sql:
WITH products(product_id) AS (VALUES (1),(2),(3),(4)),
v_sales_lines(product_id,order_date,channel,net_cents) AS (VALUES
 (1,'2025-01-01','store',600),(1,'2025-02-01','online',300),(1,'2025-03-01','store',-100),
 (2,'2025-01-01','store',200),(2,'2024-12-31','store',900)),
inventory_snapshots(product_id,warehouse_id,snapshot_date,quantity,unit_cost_cents) AS (VALUES
 (1,1,'2025-12-31',2,50),(1,2,'2025-12-31',1,100),
 (2,1,'2025-12-31',4,100),(3,1,'2025-12-31',4,100),(2,1,'2024-12-31',20,100)),
a AS (SELECT product_id,SUM(net_cents) net FROM v_sales_lines WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY product_id),
b AS (SELECT product_id,SUM(quantity*unit_cost_cents) stock FROM inventory_snapshots WHERE snapshot_date='2025-12-31' GROUP BY product_id),
z AS (SELECT p.product_id,COALESCE(a.net,0) net,COALESCE(b.stock,0) stock FROM products p LEFT JOIN a ON a.product_id=p.product_id LEFT JOIN b ON b.product_id=p.product_id),
q AS (SELECT *,100.0*net/NULLIF(SUM(net) OVER(),0) sales_share,100.0*stock/NULLIF(SUM(stock) OVER(),0) stock_share FROM z)
SELECT product_id,net net_cents,stock stock_cents,ROUND(sales_share,4) sales_pct,ROUND(stock_share,4) stock_pct,ROUND(stock_share-sales_share,4) gap_points FROM q ORDER BY gap_points DESC,product_id

mergeExamples.label: 零分母边界
mergeExamples.explanation: 全部销售净额为零时，库存占比仍可算，销售占比及差值不可定义。
mergeExamples.sql: WITH z(product_id,net,stock) AS (VALUES (1,0,200),(2,0,300)), q AS (SELECT *,100.0*net/NULLIF(SUM(net) OVER(),0) sales_share,100.0*stock/NULLIF(SUM(stock) OVER(),0) stock_share FROM z) SELECT product_id,net net_cents,stock stock_cents,ROUND(sales_share,4) sales_pct,ROUND(stock_share,4) stock_pct,ROUND(stock_share-sales_share,4) gap_points FROM q ORDER BY gap_points DESC,product_id

title: 销售毛利与库存投资回报
learningObjective: 独立计算类别期间毛利、完整两端平均库存和库存投资回报，识别快照缺档、零库存及估算口径。
concept: 期间毛利=净销售额−对应销售成本；库存标准价值=数量×单位成本；两端平均库存=(期初库存价值+期末库存价值)÷2；库存投资回报=期间毛利÷平均库存价值，单位为倍。缺少任何预期商品、仓库、日期组合的快照时不能当零；平均库存及回报留空。完整零库存的回报也不可定义。
syntax: SUM(净销售−销售成本)；SUM(两端数量×单位成本)/2.0；毛利/NULLIF(平均库存,0)
executionSteps: 检查两端库存快照并计算平均库存
左连接完整类别并计算回报
useCase: 管理层比较各商品类别2025年度每单位平均库存成本创造的毛利。纳入所有渠道，使用2024年底和2025年底各仓库存标准成本估算平均库存，每类别一行。
comparison: 库存投资回报以平均库存成本为分母；毛利率以净销售为分母；库存周转率以销售成本为分子，不能互换。

commonError.example: 以销售收入代替毛利，或将缺档库存当零、直接平均仓库快照金额。
commonError.correction: 使用对应销售成本计算毛利，确认两端完整后汇总库存价值再除以2。

notes: 保留原企业查询、预览结果及关联。原查询以快照数量判断完整性，依赖组合唯一性及数量成本字段有效；重复缺档抵消时需逐键审计。独立示例仅验证 SQLite 查询，未重建企业视图或验证原生数据库及浏览器。

teaching.problem: 管理层比较各商品类别2025年度每单位平均库存成本创造的毛利。纳入所有渠道，使用2024年底和2025年底各仓库存标准成本估算平均库存，每类别一行。
teaching.codeExplanation: a 将销售明细连接商品主档得到类别，按2025年日期筛选，先汇总净销售减成本，不再重复扣退款。b 将商品与全部仓库交叉连接形成预期组合，左连接两个指定日期快照；日期条件留在连接条件中，避免缺档被过滤。COUNT(i.snapshot_id) 只数实际匹配记录，而 COUNT(*) 会数左连接占位行。预期数量为2×类别商品数×仓库数；覆盖完整时将两端所有库存金额之和除以2.0，而不是直接平均各行金额。最后以类别主档左连接两组汇总，无销售补零，库存缺档不补零，用 NULLIF 防止零除，最后舍入四位并排序。原计数法假设每商品每仓每日期唯一；重复与缺档可能抵消，独立第五例演示逐键审计。两端平均只是估计，库存季节波动明显时应采用一致的月度或日度平均口径。
teaching.resultExplanation: 独立示例类别1毛利600分、期初库存400分、期末800分，平均600分，回报1倍；类别2毛利400分但缺一个期末仓库快照，平均库存和回报为空；类别3毛利100分、完整零库存，回报为空；类别4毛利0、平均库存200分，回报0倍；类别5无商品，平均库存和回报为空。原企业预览类别4毛利6286528分、平均库存13877168.5分、回报0.4530倍，即每一马币平均库存成本产生约0.453马币期间毛利，并非毛利率或净利润率。原企业结果仅引用未重新运行。比较类别时应统一期间、成本估值与库存覆盖口径；负毛利可以产生负回报，不能据单一指标直接决定停购。

mergeExamples.label: 按类别汇总毛利
mergeExamples.explanation: 净销售减对应销售成本；排除2024年的记录。

mergeExamples.label: 预期与实际快照数量
mergeExamples.explanation: 每件商品每仓库每个端点需要一条快照；类别2缺一条。
mergeExamples.sql:
WITH categories(category_id) AS (VALUES (1),(2),(3),(4),(5)),
products(product_id,category_id) AS (VALUES (11,1),(21,2),(31,3),(41,4)),
warehouses(warehouse_id) AS (VALUES (1),(2)),
v_sales_lines(product_id,order_date,net_cents,cost_cents) AS (VALUES
 (11,'2025-01-01',1000,600),(11,'2025-03-01',500,300),(21,'2025-02-01',700,300),(31,'2025-04-01',200,100),(11,'2024-12-31',900,100)),
inventory_snapshots(snapshot_id,product_id,warehouse_id,snapshot_date,quantity,unit_cost_cents) AS (VALUES
 (1,11,1,'2024-12-31',3,100),(2,11,2,'2024-12-31',1,100),(3,11,1,'2025-12-31',5,100),(4,11,2,'2025-12-31',3,100),
 (5,21,1,'2024-12-31',1,100),(6,21,2,'2024-12-31',1,100),(7,21,1,'2025-12-31',2,100),
 (8,31,1,'2024-12-31',0,100),(9,31,2,'2024-12-31',0,100),(10,31,1,'2025-12-31',0,100),(11,31,2,'2025-12-31',0,100),
 (12,41,1,'2024-12-31',1,100),(13,41,2,'2024-12-31',1,100),(14,41,1,'2025-12-31',1,100),(15,41,2,'2025-12-31',1,100)),
coverage AS (SELECT p.category_id,COUNT(i.snapshot_id) actual,2*COUNT(DISTINCT p.product_id)*(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM warehouses) expected FROM products p CROSS JOIN warehouses w LEFT JOIN inventory_snapshots i ON i.product_id=p.product_id AND i.warehouse_id=w.warehouse_id AND i.snapshot_date IN ('2024-12-31','2025-12-31') GROUP BY p.category_id) SELECT * FROM coverage ORDER BY category_id

mergeExamples.label: 两端库存平均值
mergeExamples.explanation: 类别1期初400、期末800，平均600；类别2缺档为空；类别3完整零库存。
mergeExamples.sql:
WITH categories(category_id) AS (VALUES (1),(2),(3),(4),(5)),
products(product_id,category_id) AS (VALUES (11,1),(21,2),(31,3),(41,4)),
warehouses(warehouse_id) AS (VALUES (1),(2)),
v_sales_lines(product_id,order_date,net_cents,cost_cents) AS (VALUES
 (11,'2025-01-01',1000,600),(11,'2025-03-01',500,300),(21,'2025-02-01',700,300),(31,'2025-04-01',200,100),(11,'2024-12-31',900,100)),
inventory_snapshots(snapshot_id,product_id,warehouse_id,snapshot_date,quantity,unit_cost_cents) AS (VALUES
 (1,11,1,'2024-12-31',3,100),(2,11,2,'2024-12-31',1,100),(3,11,1,'2025-12-31',5,100),(4,11,2,'2025-12-31',3,100),
 (5,21,1,'2024-12-31',1,100),(6,21,2,'2024-12-31',1,100),(7,21,1,'2025-12-31',2,100),
 (8,31,1,'2024-12-31',0,100),(9,31,2,'2024-12-31',0,100),(10,31,1,'2025-12-31',0,100),(11,31,2,'2025-12-31',0,100),
 (12,41,1,'2024-12-31',1,100),(13,41,2,'2024-12-31',1,100),(14,41,1,'2025-12-31',1,100),(15,41,2,'2025-12-31',1,100)),
b AS (SELECT p.category_id,CASE WHEN COUNT(i.snapshot_id)=2*COUNT(DISTINCT p.product_id)*(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM warehouses) THEN SUM(i.quantity*i.unit_cost_cents)/2.0 ELSE NULL END avg_stock FROM products p CROSS JOIN warehouses w LEFT JOIN inventory_snapshots i ON i.product_id=p.product_id AND i.warehouse_id=w.warehouse_id AND i.snapshot_date IN ('2024-12-31','2025-12-31') GROUP BY p.category_id) SELECT * FROM b ORDER BY category_id

mergeExamples.label: 完整库存投资回报报表
mergeExamples.explanation: 保留全部类别，零分母或缺档返回空值，类别4无销售但库存有效，回报为零。
mergeExamples.sql:
WITH categories(category_id) AS (VALUES (1),(2),(3),(4),(5)),
products(product_id,category_id) AS (VALUES (11,1),(21,2),(31,3),(41,4)),
warehouses(warehouse_id) AS (VALUES (1),(2)),
v_sales_lines(product_id,order_date,net_cents,cost_cents) AS (VALUES
 (11,'2025-01-01',1000,600),(11,'2025-03-01',500,300),(21,'2025-02-01',700,300),(31,'2025-04-01',200,100),(11,'2024-12-31',900,100)),
inventory_snapshots(snapshot_id,product_id,warehouse_id,snapshot_date,quantity,unit_cost_cents) AS (VALUES
 (1,11,1,'2024-12-31',3,100),(2,11,2,'2024-12-31',1,100),(3,11,1,'2025-12-31',5,100),(4,11,2,'2025-12-31',3,100),
 (5,21,1,'2024-12-31',1,100),(6,21,2,'2024-12-31',1,100),(7,21,1,'2025-12-31',2,100),
 (8,31,1,'2024-12-31',0,100),(9,31,2,'2024-12-31',0,100),(10,31,1,'2025-12-31',0,100),(11,31,2,'2025-12-31',0,100),
 (12,41,1,'2024-12-31',1,100),(13,41,2,'2024-12-31',1,100),(14,41,1,'2025-12-31',1,100),(15,41,2,'2025-12-31',1,100)),
a AS (SELECT p.category_id,SUM(s.net_cents-s.cost_cents) gross FROM v_sales_lines s JOIN products p ON p.product_id=s.product_id WHERE s.order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY p.category_id), b AS (SELECT p.category_id,CASE WHEN COUNT(i.snapshot_id)=2*COUNT(DISTINCT p.product_id)*(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM warehouses) THEN SUM(i.quantity*i.unit_cost_cents)/2.0 ELSE NULL END avg_stock FROM products p CROSS JOIN warehouses w LEFT JOIN inventory_snapshots i ON i.product_id=p.product_id AND i.warehouse_id=w.warehouse_id AND i.snapshot_date IN ('2024-12-31','2025-12-31') GROUP BY p.category_id) SELECT c.category_id,COALESCE(a.gross,0) gross_cents,b.avg_stock avg_stock_cents,ROUND(COALESCE(a.gross,0)/NULLIF(b.avg_stock,0),4) gmroi FROM categories c LEFT JOIN a ON a.category_id=c.category_id LEFT JOIN b ON b.category_id=c.category_id ORDER BY gmroi DESC,c.category_id

mergeExamples.label: 重复快照与缺档抵消检查
mergeExamples.explanation: 总行数相同不保证每个端点唯一；逐预期键检查才能识别一处重复、一处缺失。
mergeExamples.sql: WITH dates(dt) AS (VALUES ('2024-12-31'),('2025-12-31')), warehouses(w) AS (VALUES (1),(2)), snapshots(w,dt) AS (VALUES (1,'2024-12-31'),(1,'2024-12-31'),(1,'2025-12-31'),(2,'2024-12-31')) SELECT w.w,d.dt,COUNT(s.w) cnt FROM warehouses w CROSS JOIN dates d LEFT JOIN snapshots s ON s.w=w.w AND s.dt=d.dt GROUP BY w.w,d.dt HAVING COUNT(s.w)<>1 ORDER BY w.w,d.dt

title: 订单结算与收入核对
learningObjective: 独立核对净销售和净现金，识别拆分付款、失败支付、退款跨期、重复连接和零差额结果。
concept: 订单净销售属于业务收入指标，成功收款扣实际退款是资金事件净额；二者按订单及一致截止口径核对。差额为净现金减净销售。
syntax: WITH a AS (SELECT order_id,SUM(amount_cents) paid FROM payments WHERE status='settled' AND payment_date<='2025-12-31' GROUP BY order_id), b AS (SELECT i.order_id,SUM(r.refund_cents) refunded FROM returns r JOIN order_items i ON i.order_item_id=r.order_item_id WHERE r.return_date<='2025-12-31' GROUP BY i.order_id) SELECT o.order_id,o.net_cents,COALESCE(a.paid,0)-COALESCE(b.refunded,0) cash_net_cents,COALESCE(a.paid,0)-COALESCE(b.refunded,0)-o.net_cents difference_cents FROM v_order_net o LEFT JOIN a ON a.order_id=o.order_id LEFT JOIN b ON b.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' AND COALESCE(a.paid,0)-COALESCE(b.refunded,0)<>o.net_cents ORDER BY o.order_id
executionSteps: 左连接订单净额并计算差额
useCase: 财务需要核对2025年已完成订单的净销售与截至2025年12月31日成功收款扣实际退款后的现金净额。每个订单一行，只列差额非零的订单。
comparison: 净销售不等于现金流，也不等于会计确认收入；时点、手续费、预收及退款状态须按业务定义核实。

commonError.example: 直接连接付款与退款明细或纳入失败付款。
commonError.correction: 分别预聚合，按订单连接，限定成功状态与截止日期。

notes: 原企业查询及结果不变，引用 BP39.json 的零行结果。独立示例使用 SQLite 内联数据；未重新执行企业库、原生数据库或浏览器。

teaching.problem: 财务需要核对2025年已完成订单的净销售与截至2025年12月31日成功收款扣实际退款后的现金净额。每个订单一行，只列差额非零的订单。
teaching.codeExplanation: 先在付款表按状态及截止日期筛选成功收款，再按订单汇总；同一订单可能拆分支付，失败重试不计。退款表通过订单明细定位订单，按退款发生日期筛选并汇总。两个汇总表各自最多每订单一行，才与订单净额视图左连接；否则两笔付款与两笔退款相乘为四行。缺失资金事件在本题完整记录假设下补零。净现金=付款−退款，差额=净现金−净销售。最后筛选订单日期和非零差额，按订单编号排序。截止日期只设上限，允许跨期预收；净销售视图的退款截止口径需核实，不能默认为与现金事件相同。
teaching.resultExplanation: 示例订单1成功收款1000分，实际退款200分，净现金800分，与净销售一致；订单2少收50分；订单3现金比净销售多100分，可能涉及跨期退款；订单4截止日没有成功收款，差额−300分；订单5两端为零，不输出。正负差额只是核对线索，并非直接认定会计错误。原企业结果引用显示零行，说明该基准库在既定查询口径下无差额，不代表所有资金流水均已核查，也不代表查询未执行。

checkpoints.name: a

checkpoints.sql: WITH a AS (SELECT order_id,SUM(amount_cents) paid FROM payments WHERE status='settled' AND payment_date<='2025-12-31' GROUP BY order_id) SELECT * FROM a ORDER BY 1, 2 LIMIT 3;

payments(order_id,payment_date,amount_cents,status) AS (VALUES (1,'2025-02-01',600,'settled'),(1,'2025-02-02',400,'settled'),(1,'2025-02-01',1000,'failed'),(2,'2025-03-01',450,'settled'),(3,'2025-04-01',500,'settled'),(4,'2026-01-01',300,'settled'),(6,'2024-12-31',100,'settled')),
order_items(order_item_id,order_id) AS (VALUES (11,1),(12,1),(31,3)),
returns(order_item_id,return_date,refund_cents) AS (VALUES (11,'2025-02-03',100),(12,'2025-02-04',100),(31,'2026-01-01',100)),
a AS (SELECT order_id,SUM(amount_cents) paid FROM payments WHERE status='settled' AND payment_date<='2025-12-31' GROUP BY order_id),

mergeExamples.explanation: 订单1两笔成功付款与两笔退款直接连接形成四行，金额均翻倍；不能用去重金额修复。

WITH v_order_net(order_id,order_date,net_cents) AS (VALUES (1,'2025-02-01',800),(2,'2025-03-01',500),(3,'2025-04-01',400),(4,'2025-05-01',300),(5,'2025-06-01',0),(6,'2024-12-31',100)),

title: 采购承诺、收货、开票及付款敞口
learningObjective: 独立构建供应商五项金额报表，区分净开票与票面，识别连接重复，并按顺序分配合格收货以追查已付款异常发票。
concept: 采购承诺、合格收货、扣贷项净开票、实际付款及未付余额是不同业务事件的金额。各自先聚合到供应商，再对齐；未付余额是净开票减付款，并非未收货承诺。
syntax: WITH a AS (SELECT supplier_id,SUM(ordered_cents) ordered,SUM(accepted*unit_price_cents) received FROM v_po_lines GROUP BY supplier_id), b AS (SELECT supplier_id,SUM(billed_cents) billed,SUM(paid_cents) paid,SUM(balance_cents) balance FROM v_invoice_balance GROUP BY supplier_id) SELECT s.supplier_id,COALESCE(a.ordered,0) ordered_cents,COALESCE(a.received,0) received_cents,COALESCE(b.billed,0) billed_cents,COALESCE(b.paid,0) paid_cents,COALESCE(b.balance,0) balance_cents FROM suppliers s LEFT JOIN a ON a.supplier_id=s.supplier_id LEFT JOIN b ON b.supplier_id=s.supplier_id ORDER BY balance_cents DESC,s.supplier_id
executionSteps: 汇总采购承诺及合格收货
汇总净开票、付款及余额
useCase: 采购与财务需要截至2025年底按供应商对照承诺、合格收货、净开票、实付和未付余额，并识别已付款但三方不一致的发票。
comparison: 采购进度差额与应付余额不同；净开票与原始票面不同，三方匹配按原始票面和合格收货计价，不能混用净应付口径。

commonError.example: 直接连接采购行和发票行；每张发票重复使用全部合格收货量。
commonError.correction: 独立预聚合；按采购行和稳定发票顺序累计分配，按发票汇总后检查付款。

notes: 原主查询及结果 BP41.json 保持不变；需核实采购视图截止日期与快照口径。独立示例使用 SQLite 内联数据，未重新执行完整企业库、原生数据库或浏览器。

teaching.problem: 采购与财务需要截至2025年底按供应商对照承诺、合格收货、净开票、实付和未付余额，并识别已付款但三方不一致的发票。
teaching.codeExplanation: a 将采购行按供应商聚合，承诺为订购金额，收货为合格接收数量乘采购单价。b 将发票余额视图按供应商聚合，净开票已扣截止日前批准贷项，付款仅计截止日前发生的付款。两个汇总各自一供应商一行，再从供应商主档左连接，完整记录假设下缺失金额补零；按未付余额倒序。不能直接连接采购行与发票行，否则两笔采购与两张发票可形成四行。主查询未单独设置年度起点，沿用视图截至年底的累计口径，不应称为2025年度新增采购。追查已付款异常时切回采购行与发票行：按采购行分区，以发票日期、发票号与行编号确定先后，窗口累计此前开票量，当前分配量为不小于零的剩余合格数量与当前开票量的较小值。再按发票汇总原始票面、分配计价与数量差，付款在发票粒度判断，不累加重复的发票付款字段。此分配示例假定数量非负，发票顺序稳定，且为截止日已知收货的事后分配，不等于付款发生当时的收货状态。
teaching.resultExplanation: 示例供应商1承诺1500分，合格收货1300分，差额200分为尚未完成的承诺价值线索；净开票1400分减付款900分得到未付500分。供应商2余额−50分，表示净付款超过净应付，应核查预付、贷项和超付；供应商3没有记录仍显示零。追查示例采购行1合格8件，发票A先分6件，B开4件仅剩2件可分；B票面440分，分配计价200分，差240分且已付300分，应优先复核，不能直接将300分认定为损失。C没有付款，虽有差异但不进入已付款异常清单。供应商汇总差额不能替代逐发票三方核对。

checkpoints.name: a
checkpoints.label: 按供应商汇总承诺及收货金额
checkpoints.sql:
WITH a AS (SELECT supplier_id,SUM(ordered_cents) ordered,SUM(accepted*unit_price_cents) received FROM v_po_lines GROUP BY supplier_id)
SELECT * FROM a ORDER BY 1, 2, 3 LIMIT 3;

checkpoints.name: b
checkpoints.label: 按供应商汇总开票与付款
checkpoints.sql:
WITH a AS (SELECT supplier_id,SUM(ordered_cents) ordered,SUM(accepted*unit_price_cents) received FROM v_po_lines GROUP BY supplier_id), b AS (SELECT supplier_id,SUM(billed_cents) billed,SUM(paid_cents) paid,SUM(balance_cents) balance FROM v_invoice_balance GROUP BY supplier_id)
SELECT * FROM b ORDER BY 1, 2, 3, 4 LIMIT 3;

mergedConcepts.explanation: 20-16：按发票日期、发票号、行编号顺序分配采购行合格收货；每行最多分得当前开票量与剩余合格量的较小值，余额不低于零；合并至发票粒度后筛选已付款且数量或金额不一致的发票。

mergeExamples.label: 采购承诺与收货汇总
mergeExamples.explanation: 采购承诺按订购金额，收货按合格数量乘采购单价。
mergeExamples.sql:
WITH suppliers(supplier_id) AS (VALUES (1),(2),(3)),
v_po_lines(supplier_id,ordered_cents,accepted,unit_price_cents) AS (VALUES (1,1000,8,100),(1,500,5,100),(2,400,0,100)),
v_invoice_balance(supplier_id,billed_cents,paid_cents,balance_cents) AS (VALUES (1,600,600,0),(1,800,300,500),(2,100,150,-50)), a AS (SELECT supplier_id,SUM(ordered_cents) ordered,SUM(accepted*unit_price_cents) received FROM v_po_lines GROUP BY supplier_id) SELECT * FROM a ORDER BY supplier_id

mergeExamples.label: 净开票及付款汇总
mergeExamples.explanation: 净开票已扣批准贷项，余额可为负。
mergeExamples.sql:
WITH suppliers(supplier_id) AS (VALUES (1),(2),(3)),
v_po_lines(supplier_id,ordered_cents,accepted,unit_price_cents) AS (VALUES (1,1000,8,100),(1,500,5,100),(2,400,0,100)),
v_invoice_balance(supplier_id,billed_cents,paid_cents,balance_cents) AS (VALUES (1,600,600,0),(1,800,300,500),(2,100,150,-50)), b AS (SELECT supplier_id,SUM(billed_cents) billed,SUM(paid_cents) paid,SUM(balance_cents) balance FROM v_invoice_balance GROUP BY supplier_id) SELECT * FROM b ORDER BY supplier_id

mergeExamples.label: 供应商敞口报表
mergeExamples.explanation: 分别预聚合再连接供应商主档，保留无交易供应商。
mergeExamples.sql:
WITH suppliers(supplier_id) AS (VALUES (1),(2),(3)),
v_po_lines(supplier_id,ordered_cents,accepted,unit_price_cents) AS (VALUES (1,1000,8,100),(1,500,5,100),(2,400,0,100)),
v_invoice_balance(supplier_id,billed_cents,paid_cents,balance_cents) AS (VALUES (1,600,600,0),(1,800,300,500),(2,100,150,-50)), a AS (SELECT supplier_id,SUM(ordered_cents) ordered,SUM(accepted*unit_price_cents) received FROM v_po_lines GROUP BY supplier_id), b AS (SELECT supplier_id,SUM(billed_cents) billed,SUM(paid_cents) paid,SUM(balance_cents) balance FROM v_invoice_balance GROUP BY supplier_id) SELECT s.supplier_id,COALESCE(a.ordered,0) ordered_cents,COALESCE(a.received,0) received_cents,COALESCE(b.billed,0) billed_cents,COALESCE(b.paid,0) paid_cents,COALESCE(b.balance,0) balance_cents FROM suppliers s LEFT JOIN a ON a.supplier_id=s.supplier_id LEFT JOIN b ON b.supplier_id=s.supplier_id ORDER BY balance_cents DESC,s.supplier_id

mergeExamples.label: 分配合格收货
mergeExamples.explanation: 同一采购行的合格数量只能分配一次，按发票顺序分配。
mergeExamples.sql:
WITH receipts(po_item_id,accepted,unit_price) AS (VALUES (1,8,100),(2,0,100)),
invoices(invoice_id,invoice_date,invoice_no,paid_cents) AS (VALUES (1,'2025-02-01','A',600),(2,'2025-02-02','B',300),(3,'2025-02-03','C',0)),
lines(line_id,invoice_id,po_item_id,qty,price) AS (VALUES (11,1,1,6,100),(21,2,1,4,110),(31,3,2,2,100)),
seq AS (SELECT l.*,i.paid_cents,r.accepted,r.unit_price,COALESCE(SUM(l.qty) OVER(PARTITION BY l.po_item_id ORDER BY i.invoice_date,i.invoice_no,l.line_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING),0) prior_qty FROM lines l JOIN invoices i ON i.invoice_id=l.invoice_id JOIN receipts r ON r.po_item_id=l.po_item_id),
allocated AS (SELECT *,CASE WHEN accepted<=prior_qty THEN 0 WHEN accepted-prior_qty<qty THEN accepted-prior_qty ELSE qty END matched_qty FROM seq),
checked AS (SELECT invoice_id,MAX(paid_cents) paid_cents,SUM(qty) billed_qty,SUM(matched_qty) matched_qty,SUM(qty*price) face_cents,SUM(matched_qty*unit_price) expected_cents FROM allocated GROUP BY invoice_id) SELECT line_id,qty,prior_qty,matched_qty FROM allocated ORDER BY line_id

mergeExamples.label: 已付款异常发票
mergeExamples.explanation: 发票层判断存在数量或金额差异且已经发生付款；未付款异常不进入此清单。
mergeExamples.sql:
WITH receipts(po_item_id,accepted,unit_price) AS (VALUES (1,8,100),(2,0,100)),
invoices(invoice_id,invoice_date,invoice_no,paid_cents) AS (VALUES (1,'2025-02-01','A',600),(2,'2025-02-02','B',300),(3,'2025-02-03','C',0)),
lines(line_id,invoice_id,po_item_id,qty,price) AS (VALUES (11,1,1,6,100),(21,2,1,4,110),(31,3,2,2,100)),
seq AS (SELECT l.*,i.paid_cents,r.accepted,r.unit_price,COALESCE(SUM(l.qty) OVER(PARTITION BY l.po_item_id ORDER BY i.invoice_date,i.invoice_no,l.line_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING),0) prior_qty FROM lines l JOIN invoices i ON i.invoice_id=l.invoice_id JOIN receipts r ON r.po_item_id=l.po_item_id),
allocated AS (SELECT *,CASE WHEN accepted<=prior_qty THEN 0 WHEN accepted-prior_qty<qty THEN accepted-prior_qty ELSE qty END matched_qty FROM seq),
checked AS (SELECT invoice_id,MAX(paid_cents) paid_cents,SUM(qty) billed_qty,SUM(matched_qty) matched_qty,SUM(qty*price) face_cents,SUM(matched_qty*unit_price) expected_cents FROM allocated GROUP BY invoice_id) SELECT invoice_id,paid_cents,billed_qty,matched_qty,face_cents,expected_cents,face_cents-expected_cents variance_cents FROM checked WHERE paid_cents>0 AND (billed_qty<>matched_qty OR face_cents<>expected_cents) ORDER BY invoice_id

title: 渠道广告后的贡献利润
learningObjective: 独立构建渠道贡献报表，区分毛利与贡献、贡献金额与比率，解释退款及成本冲回并识别归因遗漏。
concept: 按2025年线上订单会话来源汇总净销售及毛利，并与同年广告支出对齐；广告后贡献为毛利减广告，贡献率以净销售为分母。保留全部渠道。
syntax: WITH a AS (SELECT s.source_id,SUM(o.net_cents) net,SUM(o.net_cents-o.cost_cents) gross FROM v_order_net o JOIN customer_sessions s ON s.session_id=o.session_id WHERE o.channel='online' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY s.source_id), b AS (SELECT source_id,SUM(spend_cents) spend FROM marketing_campaigns WHERE month_key BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-12' GROUP BY source_id) SELECT t.source_id,COALESCE(a.net,0) net_cents,COALESCE(a.gross,0) gross_cents,COALESCE(b.spend,0) spend_cents,COALESCE(a.gross,0)-COALESCE(b.spend,0) contribution_cents,ROUND(100.0*(COALESCE(a.gross,0)-COALESCE(b.spend,0))/NULLIF(a.net,0),2) contribution_pct FROM traffic_sources t LEFT JOIN a ON a.source_id=t.source_id LEFT JOIN b ON b.source_id=t.source_id ORDER BY contribution_cents DESC,t.source_id
executionSteps: 按渠道汇总线上净销售与毛利
独立汇总同期广告支出
左连接渠道并计算贡献
useCase: 渠道负责人希望比较2025年线上订单按会话归因的净销售、毛利及扣除当年广告费后的贡献，识别高销售但广告后亏损的渠道，并分析退款风险。
comparison: 毛利率、广告后贡献率及广告投入产出比的分子不同；广告后贡献不是最终净利润。退款率采用折后扣退款前销售额。

commonError.example: 直接连接订单与广告明细；用净销售作为退款率分母；把广告后贡献当作净利润。
commonError.correction: 分别聚合；先确认退款前口径及成本冲回；明确未扣其他费用。

notes: 原主查询及 BP44.json 结果保持不变。新增独立示例在 SQLite 内执行，未重新验证企业完整数据、原生 MySQL 或浏览器。

teaching.problem: 渠道负责人希望比较2025年线上订单按会话归因的净销售、毛利及扣除当年广告费后的贡献，识别高销售但广告后亏损的渠道，并分析退款风险。
teaching.codeExplanation: a 从订单净额视图连接会话，按订单日期选定2025年线上订单，按来源汇总净额及净额减成本。会话编号须唯一；丢失会话的订单不进入内连接结果。b 按广告月份独立汇总支出，避免同渠道多笔订单与多笔广告直接相乘。以渠道主档左连接两份汇总，无记录且确认数据完整时补零。贡献金额=毛利−广告支出；贡献率以净销售为分母，NULLIF 防止零分母，乘100.0 后再四舍五入。无销售但有广告的渠道仍显示负贡献。按金额而非比率降序排列。同一报告期使用订单日期与广告月份，并非要求会话也发生在该年；来源归因不证明广告导致销售。退款专题回到折后扣退款前的金额与原销售成本，分别汇总退款与实际冲回成本；净成本已冲回时不能再次加回。先核实退款统计截止和成本冲回口径。
teaching.resultExplanation: 渠道1净销售1000分，毛利400分，无广告支出，贡献400分、贡献率40%。渠道2净销售800分、毛利350分，但广告支出400分，贡献−50分、贡献率−6.25%。渠道3无销售仍支出100分，贡献−100分，贡献率为空；渠道4无记录但主档保留，贡献0、比率为空。退款示例中渠道1折后销售1000、成本600、退款200、成本冲回120，退款率20%，毛利由400降至320，下降80而非200。缺少会话示例有2笔、200分未归因，应另行核查。原企业结果渠道1贡献10543653分、贡献率38.73%，只是广告后贡献，不是净利润；零广告也不意味着没有其他获客成本。

WITH traffic_sources(source_id) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4),
customer_sessions(session_id,source_id) AS (SELECT 11,1 UNION ALL SELECT 12,2),
v_order_net(order_id,session_id,channel,order_date,net_cents,cost_cents) AS (
 SELECT 1,11,'online','2025-01-10',600,350 UNION ALL
 SELECT 2,11,'online','2025-02-10',400,250 UNION ALL
 SELECT 3,12,'online','2025-03-10',800,450 UNION ALL
 SELECT 4,12,'store','2025-03-10',999,100 UNION ALL
 SELECT 5,12,'online','2024-12-31',999,100),
marketing_campaigns(source_id,month_key,spend_cents) AS (
 SELECT 2,'2025-01',200 UNION ALL SELECT 2,'2025-02',200 UNION ALL
 SELECT 3,'2025-03',100 UNION ALL SELECT 2,'2024-12',999),
a AS (SELECT s.source_id,SUM(o.net_cents) net,SUM(o.net_cents-o.cost_cents) gross FROM v_order_net o JOIN customer_sessions s ON s.session_id=o.session_id WHERE o.channel='online' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY s.source_id),

mergeExamples.explanation: 退款率分母为折后扣退款前销售；退货成本加回须依据实际成本冲回，示例假设全部可冲回。

WITH sources(id) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3),
lines(source_id,discounted_cents,original_cost,refund_cents,returned_cost) AS (
 SELECT 1,1000,600,200,120 UNION ALL SELECT 2,800,450,0,0),
a AS (SELECT source_id,SUM(discounted_cents) before_sales,SUM(refund_cents) refunded,SUM(original_cost) before_cost,SUM(returned_cost) cost_reversed FROM lines GROUP BY source_id),

SELECT id,before_sales,refunded,ROUND(100.0*refunded/NULLIF(before_sales,0),2) refund_pct,before_sales-before_cost gross_before,before_sales-refunded-before_cost+cost_reversed gross_after FROM z ORDER BY id

title: 门店人效及人工占比
learningObjective: 独立构建门店人效报表，识别历史员工归属和多表重复风险，正确处理零工时、零销售及部门人工成本拆分。
concept: 按2025年线下销售与员工月历史门店分别汇总；总工作分钟=出勤分钟+加班分钟（本库两者分别记录）；每小时销售=净销售×60÷总分钟，人工占比=人工成本÷净销售×100%。保留所有门店，分母为零返回空值。
syntax: WITH a AS (SELECT store_id,SUM(net_cents) net FROM v_sales_lines WHERE channel='store' AND order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY store_id), b AS (SELECT store_id,SUM(labor_cents) labor,SUM(worked_minutes+overtime_minutes) minutes_worked FROM v_staff_month WHERE month_key BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-12' AND store_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY store_id) SELECT s.store_id,COALESCE(a.net,0) net_cents,COALESCE(b.labor,0) labor_cents,ROUND(1.0*COALESCE(b.minutes_worked,0)/60,2) worked_hours,ROUND(60.0*COALESCE(a.net,0)/NULLIF(b.minutes_worked,0),2) sales_per_hour_cents,ROUND(100.0*COALESCE(b.labor,0)/NULLIF(a.net,0),2) labor_pct FROM stores s LEFT JOIN a ON a.store_id=s.store_id LEFT JOIN b ON b.store_id=s.store_id ORDER BY s.store_id
executionSteps: 按门店汇总线下净销售
按历史门店汇总人工及工作分钟
useCase: 区域经理需要比较2025年各实体门店每小时销售及人工费用占净销售的比例，并判断成本偏高究竟来自加班、人力配置还是销售偏低。员工可能跨月调店，必须按员工月记录的历史门店归属计算。
comparison: 每小时销售衡量销售产出，人工占比衡量销售中人工负担，部门每小时人工成本衡量人力投入。组合比率先汇总分子分母。

commonError.example: 直接连接销售与员工月明细、按当前门店回填历史数据、把加班重复计入工时或人工成本。
commonError.correction: 独立预聚合并使用历史归属；确认视图字段口径；分别保护两个分母。

notes: 原主查询及 BP47.json 结果保留。独立示例仅在 SQLite 验证；未复验完整企业数据库、原生 MySQL、浏览器。来源19-54按现行合并映射整合，未逐篇复核旧课文。

teaching.problem: 区域经理需要比较2025年各实体门店每小时销售及人工费用占净销售的比例，并判断成本偏高究竟来自加班、人力配置还是销售偏低。员工可能跨月调店，必须按员工月记录的历史门店归属计算。
teaching.codeExplanation: a 以订单日期、线下渠道过滤销售明细，再按门店求净销售合计；退款已体现在净额中。b 以员工月记录的月份及当月门店归属过滤，分别求人工成本和工作分钟；不能用当前门店替代历史归属。人工成本直接取视图中的 labor_cents，不再额外加工资或奖金。先让两个汇总各自每门店一行，再连接门店主档，否则多笔销售和多名员工相乘会放大金额。COALESCE 在确认无记录代表无业务时补零；工时用分钟除60，计算人效时直接用未舍入分钟作分母，人工占比使用净销售而非毛利作分母；两个 NULLIF 分别防止除零。补充的部门人工案例按历史部门月份独立汇总员工基本工资、奖金及加班估算成本，示例按176小时/月、1.5倍时薪×加班分钟÷60，先求总成本再除总出勤加加班小时。该参数只是课程模型，不是法定薪资规则。若出勤字段已经包含加班，不应再次加总；人工成本若包含其他福利也要统一口径。
teaching.resultExplanation: 示例门店1净销售100000分，人工50000分，1200分钟=20小时，每小时5000分，人工占比50%；门店2每小时3000分、人工占比100%。门店3有销售但没有工时，人工占比50%仍可计算，人效为空；门店4有5小时却无销售，人效为0、人工占比为空；门店5无任何业务记录，两比率均为空。门店1、2组合人效4333.33分/小时，不能用两个门店的简单平均4000。部门10一月工资352000、奖金10000、加班4500，总人工366500分，355小时，人工每小时1032.39分。原企业门店1人工占比522.12%、人效308.79分/小时；超过100%不是计算错误的充分证据，应核对成本、销售数据完整性与业务口径，再判断经营风险。高人效不等于高净利润。

mergeExamples.label: 完整门店人效报表
mergeExamples.explanation: 保留所有门店，两个分母分别判断。
mergeExamples.sql:
WITH stores(store_id) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5),
v_sales_lines(store_id,channel,order_date,net_cents) AS (
 SELECT 1,'store','2025-01-01',60000 UNION ALL SELECT 1,'store','2025-02-01',40000 UNION ALL SELECT 2,'store','2025-01-01',30000 UNION ALL SELECT 3,'store','2025-01-01',20000 UNION ALL SELECT 1,'online','2025-01-01',99999 UNION ALL SELECT 1,'store','2024-12-31',99999),
v_staff_month(employee_id,store_id,month_key,labor_cents,worked_minutes,overtime_minutes) AS (
 SELECT 1,1,'2025-01',30000,540,60 UNION ALL SELECT 2,1,'2025-01',20000,540,60 UNION ALL SELECT 1,2,'2025-02',30000,600,0 UNION ALL SELECT 4,4,'2025-01',12000,300,0 UNION ALL SELECT 5,3,'2025-01',10000,0,0 UNION ALL SELECT 6,NULL,'2025-01',9000,600,0 UNION ALL SELECT 1,1,'2024-12',99999,600,0),
a AS (SELECT store_id,SUM(net_cents) net FROM v_sales_lines WHERE channel='store' AND order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY store_id), b AS (SELECT store_id,SUM(labor_cents) labor,SUM(worked_minutes+overtime_minutes) minutes_worked FROM v_staff_month WHERE month_key BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-12' AND store_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY store_id) SELECT s.store_id,COALESCE(a.net,0) net_cents,COALESCE(b.labor,0) labor_cents,ROUND(1.0*COALESCE(b.minutes_worked,0)/60,2) worked_hours,ROUND(60.0*COALESCE(a.net,0)/NULLIF(b.minutes_worked,0),2) sales_per_hour_cents,ROUND(100.0*COALESCE(b.labor,0)/NULLIF(a.net,0),2) labor_pct FROM stores s LEFT JOIN a ON a.store_id=s.store_id LEFT JOIN b ON b.store_id=s.store_id ORDER BY s.store_id

mergeExamples.label: 部门月度人工成本与加班拆分

WITH staff(employee_id,department_id,month_key,base_cents,bonus_cents,worked_minutes,overtime_minutes) AS (
 SELECT 1,10,'2025-01',176000,10000,10560,120 UNION ALL SELECT 2,10,'2025-01',176000,0,10560,60 UNION ALL SELECT 1,20,'2025-02',176000,0,10560,0),

SELECT department_id,month_key,SUM(base_cents) base_total,SUM(bonus_cents) bonus_total,ROUND(SUM(overtime_cents),2) overtime_total,ROUND(SUM(base_cents+bonus_cents+overtime_cents),2) labor_total,ROUND(SUM(worked_minutes+overtime_minutes)/60.0,2) hours,ROUND(SUM(base_cents+bonus_cents+overtime_cents)/NULLIF(SUM(worked_minutes+overtime_minutes)/60.0,0),2) labor_per_hour FROM calc GROUP BY department_id,month_key ORDER BY department_id,month_key

title: 月度经营汇总表
learningObjective: 独立构建跨业务月报并下钻门店，区分经营贡献与净利润，正确计算加权指标及滚动费用率。
concept: 每月一行。销售按订单日期、费用按分录日期、人工按员工月份、采购按订单日期、广告按活动月份独立聚合。经营贡献=毛利−费用−人工；广告与采购承诺单列，不重复扣减。无业务月份保留，确认数据完整后才补零。
syntax: WITH m AS (SELECT DISTINCT month_key FROM calendar_days WHERE month_key BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-12'), s AS (SELECT SUBSTR(order_date,1,7) m,SUM(net_cents) net,SUM(net_cents-cost_cents) gross FROM v_sales_lines WHERE order_date>='2025-01-01' GROUP BY SUBSTR(order_date,1,7)), f AS (SELECT SUBSTR(entry_date,1,7) m,SUM(expense_cents) expense FROM v_expenses WHERE entry_date>='2025-01-01' GROUP BY SUBSTR(entry_date,1,7)), h AS (SELECT month_key,SUM(labor_cents) labor FROM v_staff_month WHERE month_key BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-12' GROUP BY month_key), p AS (SELECT SUBSTR(order_date,1,7) m,SUM(ordered_cents) procurement FROM v_po_lines WHERE order_date>='2025-01-01' GROUP BY SUBSTR(order_date,1,7)), a AS (SELECT month_key,SUM(spend_cents) spend FROM marketing_campaigns WHERE month_key BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-12' GROUP BY month_key) SELECT m.month_key,COALESCE(s.net,0) net_cents,COALESCE(s.gross,0) gross_cents,COALESCE(f.expense,0) expense_cents,COALESCE(h.labor,0) labor_cents,COALESCE(a.spend,0) advertising_cents,COALESCE(p.procurement,0) committed_purchase_cents,COALESCE(s.gross,0)-COALESCE(f.expense,0)-COALESCE(h.labor,0) operating_contribution_cents FROM m LEFT JOIN s ON s.m=m.month_key LEFT JOIN f ON f.m=m.month_key LEFT JOIN h ON h.month_key=m.month_key LEFT JOIN p ON p.m=m.month_key LEFT JOIN a ON a.month_key=m.month_key ORDER BY m.month_key
executionSteps: 计算经营贡献并核对异常
useCase: 管理层需要2025年每月全渠道经营概览，将净销售、毛利、费用、人工、广告和采购承诺汇总到同一报表，并在异常月份下钻门店，区分利润、费用压力与采购资金承诺。
comparison: 经营贡献为题设毛利扣费用与人工；门店直接贡献只扣直接归属费用；采购承诺是订购金额，不等于付款或期间费用。

commonError.example: 将原始明细直接相连；重复扣广告或人工；把采购承诺当费用；平均月费用率。
commonError.correction: 按月预聚合，核对费用范围，用总分子除总分母；窗口计算前保留历史。

notes: 原主查询及 BP49.json 保留。独立示例仅在 SQLite 验证；递归日期生成使用 SQLite 专有表达式。未复验企业完整数据库、原生 MySQL、浏览器。依据现行合并映射整合三个来源，未逐篇复核旧课文。

teaching.problem: 管理层需要2025年每月全渠道经营概览，将净销售、毛利、费用、人工、广告和采购承诺汇总到同一报表，并在异常月份下钻门店，区分利润、费用压力与采购资金承诺。
teaching.codeExplanation: m 从日历去重取得12个月；s 按订单日期提取月份，汇总净销售与净销售减净成本的毛利；f 按费用入账月份汇总费用；h 按员工月汇总人工估算成本；p 按采购订单月份汇总承诺金额，而非实际付款或销售成本；a 按活动月份汇总广告支出。每个子查询先归并为一月一行，随后从 m 左连接五组结果，避免销售和费用明细多对多相乘。主查询中 s、f、p 只设起始日期，最终与2025月份轴连接限制输出；真实部署可为各模块增加截止边界以减少扫描，但本课的主查询保持原样。COALESCE 用于已确认无业务的情况，来源缺失需另作完整性核验。最后毛利减费用和人工，广告可能已入费用，不重复扣减；人工同样需确认费用中是否已包含，采购承诺不是当期损益。门店下钻时，毛利率用总毛利除总净额，目标达成率仅使用目标为正门店的实际及目标；退款率以折后扣退款前金额为分母。示例以总体加权基准比较低毛利、低达成及高退款，未知比率需另核查。门店贡献用毛利减直接归属费用；总部及未归属人工仍在口径外。滚动费用率按门店采用三个月费用合计除销售合计，在连续月份轴上用 ROWS 窗口，期初需保留报告前两个月，行数不足或分母为零留空；不得平均月比率。
teaching.resultExplanation: 独立案例1月毛利400，费用150，人工100，经营贡献150；广告50及采购承诺500单列。2月无销售但费用80、人工100，贡献为负180，不能删除该月份。3月毛利300减人工150为150。4月至12月完全无记录，示例已知无业务，全部显示0；实际数据未送达不能视为0。门店示例整体毛利率580÷1700=34.12%，正目标门店达成率1500÷1700=88.24%；门店1达成偏低且退款偏高，门店2毛利率低且直接贡献为负60，门店3目标为0不可算达成率，门店4无销售仍有费用。滚动例1月费用120÷销售1000=12%，不同于各月费率的简单平均；4月窗口净销售为0，结果为空。原企业2025年1月公布贡献2944637−65219277−51797482=−114072122分，不是完整净利润；须核验费用归属及是否重复计入人工，不据此直接认定企业亏损。

mergedConcepts.explanation: 门店下钻；整体毛利率及正目标门店达成率使用总量比率；对照整体指标筛查低毛利、低达成、高退款。
门店毛利扣直接归属费用形成门店贡献，未分摊总部费用或人工需单独注明。
连续月份上计算三个月总费用除总净销售，保留前两个月历史，窗口不足或零分母留空。

mergeExamples.label: 建立完整月份轴
mergeExamples.explanation: 使用自然月份主轴，保证无业务的月份仍然存在。独立示例使用 SQLite 日期函数生成月份；主查询使用现有日历表。

v_sales_lines(order_date,net_cents,cost_cents) AS (SELECT '2025-01-05',600,360 UNION ALL SELECT '2025-01-06',400,240 UNION ALL SELECT '2025-03-01',800,500 UNION ALL SELECT '2024-12-01',999,0 UNION ALL SELECT '2026-01-01',999,0),

mergeExamples.label: 完整月度经营汇总
mergeExamples.explanation: 各模块先变成每月一行再连接；广告和采购承诺单列，不再次扣减。
mergeExamples.sql:
WITH RECURSIVE calendar_days(month_key) AS (SELECT '2025-01' UNION ALL SELECT strftime('%Y-%m',date(month_key||'-01','+1 month')) FROM calendar_days WHERE month_key<'2025-12'),
v_sales_lines(order_date,net_cents,cost_cents) AS (SELECT '2025-01-05',600,360 UNION ALL SELECT '2025-01-06',400,240 UNION ALL SELECT '2025-03-01',800,500 UNION ALL SELECT '2024-12-01',999,0 UNION ALL SELECT '2026-01-01',999,0),
v_expenses(entry_date,expense_cents) AS (SELECT '2025-01-03',100 UNION ALL SELECT '2025-01-07',50 UNION ALL SELECT '2025-02-03',80),
v_staff_month(month_key,labor_cents) AS (SELECT '2025-01',100 UNION ALL SELECT '2025-02',100 UNION ALL SELECT '2025-03',150),
v_po_lines(order_date,ordered_cents) AS (SELECT '2025-01-04',500 UNION ALL SELECT '2025-02-06',200),
marketing_campaigns(month_key,spend_cents) AS (SELECT '2025-01',50 UNION ALL SELECT '2025-02',20),
m AS (SELECT DISTINCT month_key FROM calendar_days WHERE month_key BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-12'), s AS (SELECT SUBSTR(order_date,1,7) m,SUM(net_cents) net,SUM(net_cents-cost_cents) gross FROM v_sales_lines WHERE order_date>='2025-01-01' GROUP BY SUBSTR(order_date,1,7)), f AS (SELECT SUBSTR(entry_date,1,7) m,SUM(expense_cents) expense FROM v_expenses WHERE entry_date>='2025-01-01' GROUP BY SUBSTR(entry_date,1,7)), h AS (SELECT month_key,SUM(labor_cents) labor FROM v_staff_month WHERE month_key BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-12' GROUP BY month_key), p AS (SELECT SUBSTR(order_date,1,7) m,SUM(ordered_cents) procurement FROM v_po_lines WHERE order_date>='2025-01-01' GROUP BY SUBSTR(order_date,1,7)), a AS (SELECT month_key,SUM(spend_cents) spend FROM marketing_campaigns WHERE month_key BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-12' GROUP BY month_key) SELECT m.month_key,COALESCE(s.net,0) net_cents,COALESCE(s.gross,0) gross_cents,COALESCE(f.expense,0) expense_cents,COALESCE(h.labor,0) labor_cents,COALESCE(a.spend,0) advertising_cents,COALESCE(p.procurement,0) committed_purchase_cents,COALESCE(s.gross,0)-COALESCE(f.expense,0)-COALESCE(h.labor,0) operating_contribution_cents FROM m LEFT JOIN s ON s.m=m.month_key LEFT JOIN f ON f.m=m.month_key LEFT JOIN h ON h.month_key=m.month_key LEFT JOIN p ON p.m=m.month_key LEFT JOIN a ON a.month_key=m.month_key ORDER BY m.month_key

mergeExamples.label: 门店经营异常看板
mergeExamples.explanation: 独立门店月数据；仅正目标门店参与整体达成率；空值不等于正常，需单独复核。以整体加权指标作为示例比较基准，不是固定的业务阈值。
mergeExamples.sql:
WITH store_month(store_id,net,gross,target,refund,pre_refund,direct_expense) AS (SELECT 1,1000,400,1200,100,1100,150 UNION ALL SELECT 2,500,100,400,0,500,160 UNION ALL SELECT 3,200,80,0,0,200,20 UNION ALL SELECT 4,0,0,100,0,0,30),
benchmark AS (SELECT 100.0*SUM(gross)/NULLIF(SUM(net),0) overall_margin,100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN target>0 THEN net ELSE 0 END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN target>0 THEN target ELSE 0 END),0) overall_attainment,100.0*SUM(refund)/NULLIF(SUM(pre_refund),0) overall_refund FROM store_month),
metrics AS (SELECT *,100.0*gross/NULLIF(net,0) margin,100.0*net/NULLIF(CASE WHEN target>0 THEN target END,0) attainment,100.0*refund/NULLIF(pre_refund,0) refund_pct FROM store_month)
SELECT store_id,ROUND(margin,2) margin_pct,ROUND(attainment,2) attainment_pct,ROUND(refund_pct,2) refund_pct,ROUND(overall_margin,2) overall_margin,ROUND(overall_attainment,2) overall_attainment,CASE WHEN margin<overall_margin THEN 1 ELSE 0 END low_margin,CASE WHEN attainment<overall_attainment THEN 1 ELSE 0 END low_attainment,CASE WHEN refund_pct>overall_refund THEN 1 ELSE 0 END high_refund FROM metrics CROSS JOIN benchmark ORDER BY store_id

mergeExamples.label: 门店直接费用与贡献
mergeExamples.explanation: 示例为已归属门店直接费用的月度汇总；未分摊总部费用或另列人工，不能当作净利润。
mergeExamples.sql:
WITH store_month(store_id,net,gross,target,refund,pre_refund,direct_expense) AS (SELECT 1,1000,400,1200,100,1100,150 UNION ALL SELECT 2,500,100,400,0,500,160 UNION ALL SELECT 3,200,80,0,0,200,20 UNION ALL SELECT 4,0,0,100,0,0,30),
benchmark AS (SELECT 100.0*SUM(gross)/NULLIF(SUM(net),0) overall_margin,100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN target>0 THEN net ELSE 0 END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN target>0 THEN target ELSE 0 END),0) overall_attainment,100.0*SUM(refund)/NULLIF(SUM(pre_refund),0) overall_refund FROM store_month),
metrics AS (SELECT *,100.0*gross/NULLIF(net,0) margin,100.0*net/NULLIF(CASE WHEN target>0 THEN target END,0) attainment,100.0*refund/NULLIF(pre_refund,0) refund_pct FROM store_month)
 SELECT store_id,net,gross,direct_expense,gross-direct_expense store_contribution FROM store_month ORDER BY store_id

mergeExamples.label: 跨年滚动三个月费用率
mergeExamples.explanation: 先保留2024年11、12月，再计算窗口，最后筛选报告期。示例各门店已具备连续有效月份；生产数据需先补齐月份并验证覆盖。
mergeExamples.sql:
WITH monthly(store_id,month_key,net,expense) AS (SELECT 1,'2024-11',100,10 UNION ALL SELECT 1,'2024-12',200,40 UNION ALL SELECT 1,'2025-01',700,70 UNION ALL SELECT 1,'2025-02',0,20 UNION ALL SELECT 1,'2025-03',0,0 UNION ALL SELECT 1,'2025-04',0,0 UNION ALL SELECT 2,'2025-02',100,20 UNION ALL SELECT 2,'2025-03',100,10),
w AS (SELECT *,SUM(expense) OVER(PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY month_key ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) e3,SUM(net) OVER(PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY month_key ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) n3,COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY month_key ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) cnt FROM monthly)
SELECT store_id,month_key,ROUND(100.0*expense/NULLIF(net,0),2) monthly_pct,CASE WHEN cnt=3 THEN ROUND(100.0*e3/NULLIF(n3,0),2) END rolling_pct FROM w WHERE month_key BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-12' ORDER BY store_id,month_key
